text:
वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय
नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि।
तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णा
न्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही।।2.22।।
text_kannada:
ವಾಸಾಂಸಿ ಜೀರ್ಣಾನಿ ಯಥಾ ವಿಹಾಯ |
ನವಾನಿ ಗೃಹ್ಣಾತಿ ನರೋಽಪರಾಣಿ |
ತಥಾ ಶರೀರಾಣಿ ವಿಹಾಯ ಜೀರ್ಣಾ |
ನ್ಯನ್ಯಾನಿ ಸಂಯಾತಿ ನವಾನಿ ದೇಹೀ || ೨೨ ||
text_telugu:
వాసాంసి జీర్ణాని యథా విహాయ |
నవాని గృహ్ణాతి నరోఽపరాణి |
తథా శరీరాణి విహాయ జీర్ణా |
న్యన్యాని సంయాతి నవాని దేహీ || ౨౨ ||
transliteration:
vāsānsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya
navāni gṛihṇāti naro ’parāṇi
tathā śharīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇānya
nyāni sanyāti navāni dehī
translation_english: As after rejecting worn-out clothes, a man takes up other new ones, likewise, after rejecting worn-out bodies, the embodied one unites with other new ones.
translation_kannada: ಮನುಷ್ಯನು ಹಳೆಯ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೊಸ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೊಡುವಂತೆ, ದೇಹಧಾರಿಯಾದ ಆತ್ಮನು ಹಳೆಯ ದೇಹಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೊಸ ದೇಹಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
translation_telugu: మానవుడు జీర్ణమైన వస్త్రాలను విసర్జించి క్రొత్త వాటిని ఎలా ధరిస్తాడో అలాగే దేహధారి జీర్ణమైన శరీరాలను విసర్జించి క్రొత్తవాటిని స్వీకరిస్తాడు.

commentary_english: Yatha, as in the world; vihaya, after rejecting jirnani, wornout; vasamsi, clothes; narah, a man grhnati, takes up; aparani, other; navani, new ones; tatha, likewise, in that very manner; vihaya, after rejecting; jirnani, wornout; sarirani, bodies; dehi, the embodied one, the Self which is surely unchanging like the man (in the example); samyati, unites with; anyani, other; navani, new ones. text:
नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः।
न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः।।2.23।।
text_kannada:
ನೈನಂ ಛಿಂದಂತಿ ಶಸ್ತ್ರಾಣಿ ನೈನಂ ದಹತಿ ಪಾವಕಃ |
ನ ಚೈನಂ ಕ್ಲೇದಯಂತ್ಯಾಪೋ ನ ಶೋಷಯತಿ ಮಾರುತಃ || ೨೩ ||
text_telugu:
నైనం ఛిందంతి శస్త్రాణి నైనం దహతి పావకః |
న చైనం క్లేదయంత్యాపో న శోషయతి మారుతః || ౨౩ ||
transliteration:
nainaṁ chhindanti śhastrāṇi nainaṁ dahati pāvakaḥ
na chainaṁ kledayantyāpo na śhoṣhayati mārutaḥ
translation_english: Weapons cannot cut It, fire cannot burn It, water cannot moisten It, and air cannot dry It.
translation_kannada: ಇವನನ್ನು ಶಸ್ತ್ರಗಳು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಲಾರವು, ಬೆಂಕಿ ಸುಡಲಾರದು, ನೀರು ನೆನೆಸಲಾರದು, ಗಾಳಿ ಒಣಗಿಸಲಾರದು.
translation_telugu: దీనిని శస్త్రాలు ఛేదించలేవు, అగ్ని దహించలేదు, నీరు తడపలేదు, గాలి ఎండించలేదు.
context_english: na—not; enam—this soul; chhindanti—shred; śhastrāṇi—weapons; na—nor; enam—this soul; dahati—burns; pāvakaḥ—fire; na—not; cha—and; enam—this soul; kledayanti—moisten; āpaḥ—water; na—nor; śhoṣhayati—dry; mārutaḥ—wind
commentary_english: The Self is indivisible. It has no parts. It is extremely subtle. It is infinite. Therefore, sword cannot cut It fire cannot burn It water cannot wet It wind cannot dry It.

text:
अच्छेद्योऽयमदाह्योऽयमक्लेद्योऽशोष्य एव च।
नित्यः सर्वगतः स्थाणुरचलोऽयं सनातनः।।2.24।।
text_kannada:
ಅಚ್ಛೇದ್ಯೋಽಯಮದಾಹ್ಯೋಽಯಮಕ್ಲೇದ್ಯೋಽಶೋಷ್ಯ ಏವ ಚ |
ನಿತ್ಯಃ ಸರ್ವಗತಃ ಸ್ಥಾಣುರಚಲೋಽಯಂ ಸನಾತನಃ || ೨೪ ||
text_telugu:
అచ్ఛేద్యోఽయమదాహ్యోఽయమక్లేద్యోఽశోష్య ఏవ చ |
నిత్యః సర్వగతః స్థాణురచలోఽయం సనాతనః || ౨౪ ||
transliteration:
achchhedyo ’yam adāhyo ’yam akledyo ’śhoṣhya eva cha
nityaḥ sarva-gataḥ sthāṇur achalo ’yaṁ sanātanaḥ
translation_english: It cannot be cut, burned, moistened, or dried up; it is eternal, omnipresent, stationary, unmoving, and unchanging.
translation_kannada: ಇವನನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಲಾಗದು, ಸುಡಲಾಗದು, ನೆನೆಸಲಾಗದು, ಒಣಗಿಸಲಾಗದು. ಇವನು ನಿತ್ಯನು, ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಇರುವವನು, ಸ್ಥಿರನು, ಚಲಿಸದವನು, ಸನಾತನನು.
translation_telugu: ఇది ఛేధించ రానిది, కాల్చ రానిది, తడప రానిది, ఎండించ రానిది. నిత్యము, సర్వవ్యాపకము, స్థిరము, అచలమైనది.
context_english: achchhedyaḥ—unbreakable; ayam—this soul; adāhyaḥ—incombustible; ayam—this soul; akledyaḥ—cannot be dampened; aśhoṣhyaḥ—cannot be dried; eva—indeed; cha—and; nityaḥ—everlasting; sarva-gataḥ—all-pervading; sthāṇuḥ—unalterable; achalaḥ—immutable; ayam—this soul; sanātanaḥ—primordial
commentary_english:
The Self is very subtle. It is beyond the reach of speech and mind. It is very difficult to understand this subtle Self. So Lord Krishna explains the nature of the immortal Self in a variety of ways with various illustrations and examples, so that It can be grasped by the people.Sword cannot cut this Self. It is eternal. Because It is eternal? It is allpervading. Because It is allpervading? It is stable like a stature. Because It is stable? It is immovable. It is everlasting.

Therefore? It is not produced out of any cause. It is not new. It is ancient.

commentary_kannada:
ಆತ್ಮವು ಬಹಳ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮವಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದು ಮಾತು ಮತ್ತು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಮೀರಿದೆ. ಈ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಆತ್ಮವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಬಹಳ ಕಷ್ಟ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಭಗವಾನ್ ಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಅಮರ ಆತ್ಮದ ಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು ವಿವಿಧ ವಿವರಣೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ವಿವಿಧ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಇದರಿಂದ ಜನರು ಅದನ್ನು ಗ್ರಹಿಸಬಹುದು. ಖಡ್ಗವು ಈ ಆತ್ಮವನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಅದು ಶಾಶ್ವತವಾದುದು. ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಅದು ಶಾಶ್ವತವಾಗಿದೆ? ಇದು ಸರ್ವವ್ಯಾಪಿ. ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಅದು ಸರ್ವವ್ಯಾಪಿ ಆಗಿದೆ? ಇದು ಎತ್ತರದಂತೆ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿದೆ. ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಅದು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿದೆ? ಇದು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿದೆ. ಅದು ಶಾಶ್ವತವಾದುದು.

ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ? ಇದು ಯಾವುದೇ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕೂ ಉತ್ಪತ್ತಿಯಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದು ಹೊಸದೇನೂ ಅಲ್ಲ. ಇದು ಪುರಾತನವಾದದ್ದು.

text:
अव्यक्तोऽयमचिन्त्योऽयमविकार्योऽयमुच्यते।
तस्मादेवं विदित्वैनं नानुशोचितुमर्हसि।।2.25।।
text_kannada:
ಅವ್ಯಕ್ತೋಽಯಮಚಿಂತ್ಯೋಽಯಮವಿಕಾರ್ಯೋಽಯಮುಚ್ಯತೇ |
ತಸ್ಮಾದೇವಂ ವಿದಿತ್ವೈನಂ ನಾನುಶೋಚಿತುಮರ್ಹಸಿ || ೨೫ ||
text_telugu:
అవ్యక్తోఽయమచింత్యోఽయమవికార్యోఽయముచ్యతే |
తస్మాదేవం విదిత్వైనం నానుశోచితుమర్హసి || ౨౫ ||
transliteration:
avyakto ’yam achintyo ’yam avikāryo ’yam uchyate
tasmādevaṁ viditvainaṁ nānuśhochitum arhasi
translation_english: It is said that This is unmanifest; This is inconceivable; This is unchangeable. Therefore, having known This thus, you ought not to grieve.
translation_kannada: ಇವನು ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಕಾಣದವನು, ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ನಿಲುಕದವನು, ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯಿಲ್ಲದವನು ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಇವನನ್ನು ಹೀಗೆ ತಿಳಿದು ನೀನು ಶೋಕಿಸಬಾರದು.
translation_telugu: ఇది వ్యక్తం కానిది, యోచించడానికి వీలు లేనిది, వికారాలు లేనిది అని చెప్పబడుతుంది. దీనిని నీవు అర్ధం చేసుకుని విచారంచడం విడిచి పెట్టు.
context_english: avyaktaḥ—unmanifested; ayam—this soul; achintyaḥ—inconceivable; ayam—this soul; avikāryaḥ—unchangeable; ayam—this soul; uchyate—is said; tasmāt—therefore; evam—thus; viditvā—having known; enam—this soul; na—not; anuśhochitum—to grieve; arhasi—befitting
commentary_english:
The Self is not an object of perception. It can hardly be seen by the physical eyes. Therefore, the Self is unmanifested. That which is seen by the eyes becomes an object of thought. As the Self cannot be perceived by the eyes? It is unthinkable. Milk when mixed with buttermilk changes its form. The Self cannot change Its form like milk.

Hence? It is changeless and immutable. Therefore, thus understanding the Self, thou shouldst not mourn. Thou shouldst not think also that thou art their slayer and that they are killed by thee.

commentary_kannada:
ಆತ್ಮವು ಗ್ರಹಿಕೆಯ ವಸ್ತುವಲ್ಲ. ಇದನ್ನು ಭೌತಿಕ ಕಣ್ಣುಗಳಿಂದ ನೋಡಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, ಆತ್ಮವು ಅಪ್ರಕಟಿತವಾಗಿದೆ. ಕಣ್ಣುಗಳು ಏನನ್ನು ನೋಡುತ್ತವೆಯೋ ಅದು ಚಿಂತನೆಯ ವಸ್ತುವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆತ್ಮವನ್ನು ಕಣ್ಣುಗಳಿಂದ ಗ್ರಹಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲವೇ? ಇದು ಊಹಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲೂ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯ. ಹಾಲನ್ನು ಮಜ್ಜಿಗೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೆರೆಸಿದಾಗ ಅದರ ರೂಪವು ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆತ್ಮವು ತನ್ನ ರೂಪವನ್ನು ಹಾಲಿನಂತೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.

ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ? ಇದು ಬದಲಾಗದ ಮತ್ತು ಬದಲಾಗದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, ಆತ್ಮವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು, ನೀವು ದುಃಖಿಸಬಾರದು. ನೀನೇ ಅವರ ಕೊಲೆಗಾರನೆಂದೂ, ಅವರು ನಿನ್ನಿಂದಲೇ ಕೊಲ್ಲಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆಂದೂ ನೀವು ಯೋಚಿಸಬಾರದು.

text:
अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम्।
तथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि।।2.26।।
text_kannada:
ಅಥ ಚೈನಂ ನಿತ್ಯಜಾತಂ ನಿತ್ಯಂ ವಾ ಮನ್ಯಸೇ ಮೃತಮ್ |
ತಥಾಪಿ ತ್ವಂ ಮಹಾಬಾಹೋ ನೈವಂ ಶೋಚಿತುಮರ್ಹಸಿ || ೨೬ ||
text_telugu:
అథ చైనం నిత్యజాతం నిత్యం వా మన్యసే మృతమ్ |
తథాపి త్వం మహాబాహో నైవం శోచితుమర్హసి || ౨౬ ||
transliteration:
atha chainaṁ nitya-jātaṁ nityaṁ vā manyase mṛitam
tathāpi tvaṁ mahā-bāho naivaṁ śhochitum arhasi
translation_english: On the other hand, if you think this One is born continually or constantly dies, even then, O mighty-armed one, you should not grieve.
translation_kannada: ಇನ್ನು ಇವನು ಸದಾ ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸದಾ ಸಾಯುತ್ತಾನೆ ಎಂದೇ ನೀನು ಭಾವಿಸಿದರೂ, ಮಹಾಬಾಹುವೇ, ಹಾಗಿದ್ದರೂ ನೀನು ಶೋಕಿಸಬಾರದು.
translation_telugu: ఇక దీనిని నిత్యం పుట్టేది, నిత్యం గిట్టేదిగా భావించినా మహానుభావుడా అప్పుడు కూడా ఇలా విచారించ తగదు.
context_english: atha—if, however; cha—and; enam—this soul; nitya-jātam—taking constant birth; nityam—always; vā—or; manyase—you think; mṛitam—dead; tathā api—even then; tvam—you; mahā-bāho—mighty-armed one, Arjun; na—not; evam—like this; śhochitum—grieve; arhasi—befitting
commentary_english: Lord Krishna here, for the sake of argument, takes up the popular supposition. Granting that the Self is again and again born whenever a body comes into being, and again and again dies whenever the body dies? O mightyarmed (O Arjuna of great valour and strength), thou shouldst not grieve thus, because birth is inevitable to want is dead and death is inevitable to what is born. This is the inexorable or unrelenting Law of Nature.

commentary_kannada: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಭಗವಾನ್ ಕೃಷ್ಣನು, ವಾದದ ಸಲುವಾಗಿ, ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ ಊಹೆಯನ್ನು ಕೈಗೆತ್ತಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದೇಹವು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದಾಗಲೆಲ್ಲಾ ಆತ್ಮವು ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಜನಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ದೇಹವು ಸತ್ತಾಗಲೆಲ್ಲಾ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಸಾಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು? ಓ ಪರಾಕ್ರಮಶಾಲಿ (ಓ ಮಹಾ ಶೌರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಅರ್ಜುನ), ನೀನು ಹೀಗೆ ದುಃಖಿಸಬಾರದು, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಹುಟ್ಟುವುದು ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ, ಹಸಿವು ಸತ್ತದ್ದು ಮತ್ತು ಹುಟ್ಟಿದವನಿಗೆ ಸಾವು ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದು ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯ ಅಳಿಸಲಾಗದ ಅಥವಾ ನಿರಂತರ ನಿಯಮವಾಗಿದೆ.

text:
जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च।
तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि।।2.27।।
text_kannada:
ಜಾತಸ್ಯ ಹಿ ಧ್ರುವೋ ಮೃತ್ಯುರ್ಧ್ರುವಂ ಜನ್ಮ ಮೃತಸ್ಯ ಚ |
ತಸ್ಮಾದಪರಿಹಾರ್ಯೇಽರ್ಥೇ ನ ತ್ವಂ ಶೋಚಿತುಮರ್ಹಸಿ || ೨೭ ||
text_telugu:
జాతస్య హి ధ్రువో మృత్యుర్ధ్రువం జన్మ మృతస్య చ |
తస్మాదపరిహార్యేఽర్థే న త్వం శోచితుమర్హసి || ౨౭ ||
transliteration:
jātasya hi dhruvo mṛityur dhruvaṁ janma mṛitasya cha
tasmād aparihārye ’rthe na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi
translation_english: For the death of anyone born is certain, and the rebirth of the dead is certain. Therefore, you should not grieve over an inevitable fact.
translation_kannada: ಹುಟ್ಟಿದವನಿಗೆ ಸಾವು ಖಚಿತ, ಸತ್ತವನಿಗೆ ಹುಟ್ಟು ಖಚಿತ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲಾಗದ ಈ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀನು ಶೋಕಿಸಬಾರದು.
translation_telugu: పుట్టిన వానికి మరణం ఎలా తప్పదో, అలాగే చనిపోయిన వారికి జన్మ తప్పదు. అందుచేత శోకింపనవసరం లేని దాని కోసం నీవు శోకింప తగదు.
context_english: jātasya—for one who has been born; hi—for; dhruvaḥ—certain; mṛityuḥ—death; dhruvam—certain; janma—birth; mṛitasya—for the dead; cha—and; tasmāt—therefore; aparihārye arthe—in this inevitable situation; na—not; tvam—you; śhochitum—lament; arhasi—befitting
commentary_english: Birth is sure to happen to that which is dead death is sure to happen to what which is born. Birth and death are certainly unavoidable. Therefore, you should not grieve over an inevitable matter.

commentary_kannada: ಯಾವುದು ಸತ್ತಿದೆಯೋ ಅದು ಹುಟ್ಟುವುದು ಖಚಿತ, ಯಾವುದು ಹುಟ್ಟಿದೆಯೋ ಅದು ಸಾವು ಖಚಿತ. ಹುಟ್ಟು ಮತ್ತು ಸಾವು ಖಂಡಿತವಾಗಿಯೂ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯವಾಗಿವೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯವಾದ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನೀವು ದುಃಖಿಸಬಾರದು.

text:
अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत।
अव्यक्तनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना।।2.28।।
text_kannada:
ಅವ್ಯಕ್ತಾದೀನಿ ಭೂತಾನಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಮಧ್ಯಾನಿ ಭಾರತ |
ಅವ್ಯಕ್ತನಿಧನಾನ್ಯೇವ ತತ್ರ ಕಾ ಪರಿದೇವನಾ || ೨೮ ||
text_telugu:
అవ్యక్తాదీని భూతాని వ్యక్తమధ్యాని భారత |
అవ్యక్తనిధనాన్యేవ తత్ర కా పరిదేవనా || ౨౮ ||
transliteration:
avyaktādīni bhūtāni vyakta-madhyāni bhārata
avyakta-nidhanānyeva tatra kā paridevanā
translation_english: O descendant of Bharata, all beings remain unmanifested in the beginning; they become manifested in the middle. After death, they certainly become unmanifested. What lamentation can there be for them?
translation_kannada: ಭರತವಂಶದವನೇ, ಜೀವಿಗಳು ಮೊದಲು ಕಾಣದವು, ನಡುವೆ ಕಾಣುವವು, ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಕಾಣದವು. ಹಾಗಿರುವಾಗ ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ದುಃಖಿಸುವುದೇನಿದೆ?
translation_telugu: అర్జునా జీవుని మొదలెక్కడో తెలియదు, మధ్య ఎమిటో తెలియదు, తుది ఎప్పుడో తెలియదు. తెలియని దాని కొరకు విచారించ పనిలేదు.
context_english: avyakta-ādīni—unmanifest before birth; bhūtāni—created beings; vyakta—manifest; madhyāni—in the middle; bhārata—Arjun, scion of Bharat; avyakta—unmanifest; nidhanāni—on death; eva—indeed; tatra—therefore; kā—why; paridevanā—grieve
commentary_english:
The physical body is a combination of the five elements. It is seen by the physical eyes only after the five elements have entered into such combination. After death, the body disintegrates and the five elements go back to their source it cannot be seen. Therefore, the body can be seen only in the middle state. The relationship as son, friend, teacher, father, mother, wife, brother and sister is formed through the body on account of attachment and Moha (delusion).

Just as planks unite and separate in a river, just as pilgrims unite and separate in a public inn, so also fathers, mothers, sons and brothers unite and separate in this world. This world is a very big public inn. People unite and separate.There is no pot in the beginning and in the end. Even if you see the pot in the middle, you should think and feel that it is illusory and does not really exist.

So also there is no body in the beginning and in the end. That which does not exist in the beginning and in the end must be illusory in the middle also. You must think and feel that the body does not really exist in the middle as well.He who thus understands the nature of the body and all human relationships based on it, will not grieve.

commentary_kannada:
ಭೌತಿಕ ದೇಹವು ಐದು ಅಂಶಗಳ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಐದು ಅಂಶಗಳು ಅಂತಹ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಗೆ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿದ ನಂತರವೇ ಭೌತಿಕ ಕಣ್ಣುಗಳು ಇದನ್ನು ನೋಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಾವಿನ ನಂತರ, ದೇಹವು ವಿಭಜನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಐದು ಅಂಶಗಳು ತಮ್ಮ ಮೂಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗುತ್ತವೆ, ಅದನ್ನು ನೋಡಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಮಧ್ಯಮ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು. ಮಗ, ಸ್ನೇಹಿತ, ಶಿಕ್ಷಕ, ತಂದೆ, ತಾಯಿ, ಪತ್ನಿ, ಸಹೋದರ ಮತ್ತು ಸಹೋದರಿಯ ಸಂಬಂಧವು ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮೋಹ (ಭ್ರಮೆ) ಯಿಂದಾಗಿ ದೇಹದ ಮೂಲಕ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

ನದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲಗೆಗಳು ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿದಂತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇರ್ಪಟ್ಟಂತೆ, ಯಾತ್ರಿಕರು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಸತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿದಂತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇರ್ಪಟ್ಟಂತೆ, ತಂದೆ, ತಾಯಿ, ಪುತ್ರರು ಮತ್ತು ಸಹೋದರರು ಕೂಡ ಈ ಜಗತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಗ್ಗೂಡುತ್ತಾರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇರ್ಪಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಈ ಜಗತ್ತು ಬಹಳ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ವಸತಿಗೃಹವಾಗಿದೆ. ಜನರು ಒಗ್ಗೂಡುತ್ತಾರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇರ್ಪಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೇ ಮಡಕೆ ಇಲ್ಲ. ನೀವು ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಡಕೆಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಿದರೂ, ಅದು ಭ್ರಮೆಯಾಗಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಜವಾಗಿಯೂ ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ನೀವು ಯೋಚಿಸಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾವಿಸಬೇಕು.

ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೇ ದೇಹವಿಲ್ಲ. ಯಾವುದು ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿಲ್ಲವೋ ಅದು ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಭ್ರಮೆಯಾಗಿರಬೇಕು. ದೇಹವು ನಿಜವಾಗಿಯೂ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ನೀವು ಯೋಚಿಸಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಅನುಭವಿಸಬೇಕು. ಹೀಗೆ ದೇಹದ ಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮಾನವ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವವನು ದುಃಖಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

text:
आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेन
माश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः।
आश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः श्रृणोति
श्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्चित्।।2.29।।
text_kannada:
ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯವತ್ಪಶ್ಯತಿ ಕಶ್ಚಿದೇನ |
ಮಾಶ್ಚರ್ಯವದ್ವದತಿ ತಥೈವ ಚಾನ್ಯಃ |
ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯವಚ್ಚೈನಮನ್ಯಃ ಶ್ರೃಣೋತಿ |
ಶ್ರುತ್ವಾಪ್ಯೇನಂ ವೇದ ನ ಚೈವ ಕಶ್ಚಿತ್ || ೨೯ ||
text_telugu:
ఆశ్చర్యవత్పశ్యతి కశ్చిదేన |
మాశ్చర్యవద్వదతి తథైవ చాన్యః |
ఆశ్చర్యవచ్చైనమన్యః శ్రృణోతి |
శ్రుత్వాప్యేనం వేద న చైవ కశ్చిత్ || ౨౯ ||
transliteration:
āśhcharya-vat paśhyati kaśhchid enan

translation_english: Someone visualizes it as a wonder; someone else talks of it as a wonder; someone else hears of it as a wonder; and yet someone else does not even realize it after hearing about it.
translation_kannada: ಕೆಲವರು ಈ ಆತ್ಮನನ್ನು ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯದಂತೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಕೆಲವರು ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯದಂತೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಇನ್ನು ಕೆಲವರು ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯದಂತೆ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕೇಳಿದರೂ ಯಾರೂ ಇವನನ್ನು ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
translation_telugu: దీనిని ఒకడు ఆశ్చర్యంగా చూస్తాడు, ఒకరు ఆశ్చర్యంగా చెబుతాడు, ఒకడు ఆశ్చర్యంగా వింటాడు. అయినప్పటికీ ఎవరూ దీనిని తెలుసుకోలేరు.
context_english: āśhcharya-vat—as amazing; paśhyati—see; kaśhchit—someone; enam—this soul; āśhcharya-vat—as amazing; vadati—speak of; tathā—thus; eva—indeed; cha—and; anyaḥ—other; āśhcharya-vat—similarly amazing; cha—also; enam—this soul; anyaḥ—others; śhṛiṇoti—hear; śhrutvā—having heard; api—even; enam—this soul; veda—understand; na—not; cha—and; eva—even; kaśhchit—some
commentary_english: The verse may also be interpreted in this manner. He that sees, hears and speaks of the Self is a wonderful man. Such a man is very rare. He is one among many thousands. Thus the Self is very hard to understand.

देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत।

text_kannada:

text_telugu:

తస్మాత్సర్వాణి భూతాని న త్వం శోచితుమర్హసి || ౩౦ ||

translation_english: O descendant of Bharata, this embodied Self existing in everyone's body can never be killed; therefore, you ought not to grieve for all these beings.

context_english: dehī—the soul that dwells within the body; nityam—always; avadhyaḥ—immortal; ayam—this soul; dehe—in the body; sarvasya—of everyone; bhārata—descendant of Bharat, Arjun; tasmāt—therefore; sarvāṇi—for all; bhūtāni—living entities; na—not; tvam—you; śhochitum—mourn; arhasi—should
commentary_english: The body of any creature may be destroyed but the Self cannot be killed. Therefore you should not grieve regarding any creature whatever? Bhishma or anybody else.

commentary_kannada: ಭಗವಾನ್ ಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಈಗ ಅರ್ಜುನನಿಗೆ ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತಿನ ಕಾರಣಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಈ ಸಮಯದವರೆಗೆ? ಆತ ಅರ್ಜುನನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಆತ್ಮದ ಅಮರತ್ವದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದರು ಮತ್ತು ಆತನಿಗೆ ತಾತ್ವಿಕ ಕಾರಣಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡಿದರು. ಈಗ ಅವನು ಅರ್ಜುನನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ? ಓ ಅರ್ಜುನ, ಹೋರಾಟ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಕ್ಷತ್ರಿಯರ ಸ್ವಂತ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ನೀವು ಆ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯದಿಂದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಸರಿಯಬಾರದು. ಕ್ಷತ್ರಿಯನಿಗೆ (ಯೋಧ ಅಥವಾ ಆಡಳಿತ ವರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದವನು) ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸ್ವಾಗತಾರ್ಹವಾದದ್ದು ಯಾವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಯೋಧನು ಹೋರಾಡಬೇಕು.

text:
यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम्।
सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम्।।2.32।।
text_kannada:
ಯದೃಚ್ಛಯಾ ಚೋಪಪನ್ನಂ ಸ್ವರ್ಗದ್ವಾರಮಪಾವೃತಮ್ |
ಸುಖಿನಃ ಕ್ಷತ್ರಿಯಾಃ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಲಭಂತೇ ಯುದ್ಧಮೀದೃಶಮ್ || ೩೨ ||
text_telugu:
యదృచ్ఛయా చోపపన్నం స్వర్గద్వారమపావృతమ్ |
సుఖినః క్షత్రియాః పార్థ లభంతే యుద్ధమీదృశమ్ || ౩౨ ||
transliteration:
yadṛichchhayā chopapannaṁ swarga-dvāram apāvṛitam
sukhinaḥ kṣhatriyāḥ pārtha labhante yuddham īdṛiśham
translation_english: O son of Partha, happy are the Kshatriyas who come across such a battle, which presents itself unsought and is an open gate to heaven.
translation_kannada: ಪಾರ್ಥನೇ, ತಾನಾಗಿಯೇ ಒದಗಿ ಬಂದ, ತೆರೆದ ಸ್ವರ್ಗದ ಬಾಗಿಲಿನಂತಿರುವ ಇಂಥ ಯುದ್ಧವನ್ನು ಪುಣ್ಯವಂತರಾದ ಕ್ಷತ್ರಿಯರು ಮಾತ್ರ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
translation_telugu: అర్జునా! యాదృచ్చికంగా లభించినదీ స్వర్గద్వారాన్ని తెరిపించేదీ అయిన ఇలాంటి యుద్ధంలో పాల్గొనే అవకాశం అదృష్టవంతులైన క్షత్రియులే పొందుతారు.
context_english: yadṛichchhayā—unsought; cha—and; upapannam—come; swarga—celestial abodes; dvāram—door; apāvṛitam—wide open; sukhinaḥ—happy; kṣhatriyāḥ—warriors; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; labhante—obtain; yuddham—war; īdṛiśham—such
commentary_english: The scriptures declare that if a Kshatriya dies for a righteous cause on the battlefield, he at once goes to heaven.
translation_kannada_source: machine-assisted — rendered from the Sanskrit, no traditional Kannada edition
commentary_kannada: ಕ್ಷತ್ರಿಯನು ಯುದ್ಧಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತವಾದ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಸತ್ತರೆ, ಅವನು ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಸ್ವರ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ ಎಂದು ಧರ್ಮಗ್ರಂಥಗಳು ಘೋಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
commentary_kannada_source: machine-translated from the English commentary by IndicTrans2 (ai4bharat/indictrans2-en-indic-1B)

text:
अथ चैत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि।
ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि।।2.33।।
text_kannada:
ಅಥ ಚೈತ್ತ್ವಮಿಮಂ ಧರ್ಮ್ಯಂ ಸಂಗ್ರಾಮಂ ನ ಕರಿಷ್ಯಸಿ |
ತತಃ ಸ್ವಧರ್ಮಂ ಕೀರ್ತಿಂ ಚ ಹಿತ್ವಾ ಪಾಪಮವಾಪ್ಸ್ಯಸಿ || ೩೩ ||
text_telugu:
అథ చైత్త్వమిమం ధర్మ్యం సంగ్రామం న కరిష్యసి |
తతః స్వధర్మం కీర్తిం చ హిత్వా పాపమవాప్స్యసి || ౩౩ ||
transliteration:
atha chet tvam imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṅgrāmaṁ na kariṣhyasi
tataḥ sva-dharmaṁ kīrtiṁ cha hitvā pāpam avāpsyasi
translation_english: On the other hand, if you do not fight this righteous battle, then you will incur sin, forsaking your own duty and fame.
translation_kannada: ಒಂದು ವೇಳೆ ಧರ್ಮಬದ್ಧವಾದ ಈ ಯುದ್ಧವನ್ನು ನೀನು ಮಾಡದಿದ್ದರೆ, ಸ್ವಧರ್ಮವನ್ನೂ ಕೀರ್ತಿಯನ್ನೂ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಪಾಪವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತೀಯೆ.
translation_telugu: ధార్మికమైన ఈ యుద్ధాన్ని చేయకపోయ్యావో, దానివల్ల స్వధర్మాన్ని, కీర్తిని వదిలినవాడవై పాపం పొందుతావు.
context_english: atha chet—if, however; tvam—you; imam—this; dharmyam saṅgrāmam—righteous war; na—not; kariṣhyasi—act; tataḥ—then; sva-dharmam—one’s duty in accordance with the Vedas; kīrtim—reputation; cha—and; hitvā—abandoning; pāpam—sin; avāpsyasi—will incur
commentary_english: The Lord reminds Arjuna of the fame he had already earned and which he would now lose if he refused to fight. Arjuna had acquired great fame by fighting with Lord Siva. Arjuna proceeded on a pilgrimage to the Himalayas. He fought with Siva Who appeared in the guise of a mountaineer (Kirata) and got from Him the Pasupatastra, a celestial weapon.

commentary_kannada: ಭಗವಂತನು ಅರ್ಜುನನಿಗೆ ತಾನು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಗಳಿಸಿದ್ದ ಖ್ಯಾತಿಯನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅವನು ಹೋರಾಡಲು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿದರೆ ಅದನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಶಿವನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡುವ ಮೂಲಕ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಖ್ಯಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಗಳಿಸಿದ್ದನು. ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಹಿಮಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ತೀರ್ಥಯಾತ್ರೆ ಕೈಗೊಂಡನು. ಅವನು ಪರ್ವತಾರೋಹಿ (ಕಿರಾತ) ನ ವೇಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ಶಿವನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡಿದನು ಮತ್ತು ಅವನಿಂದ ಆಕಾಶದ ಆಯುಧವಾದ ಪಶುಪಟಾಸ್ತ್ರವನ್ನು ಪಡೆದನು.

text:
अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम्।
संभावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते।।2.34।।
text_kannada:
ಅಕೀರ್ತಿಂ ಚಾಪಿ ಭೂತಾನಿ ಕಥಯಿಷ್ಯಂತಿ ತೇಽವ್ಯಯಾಮ್ |
ಸಂಭಾವಿತಸ್ಯ ಚಾಕೀರ್ತಿರ್ಮರಣಾದತಿರಿಚ್ಯತೇ || ೩೪ ||
text_telugu:
అకీర్తిం చాపి భూతాని కథయిష్యంతి తేఽవ్యయామ్ |
సంభావితస్య చాకీర్తిర్మరణాదతిరిచ్యతే || ౩౪ ||
transliteration:
akīrtiṁ chāpi bhūtāni
kathayiṣhyanti te ’vyayām
sambhāvitasya chākīrtir
maraṇād atirichyate
translation_english: People also will speak of your unending infamy, and to an honored person, infamy is worse than death.
translation_kannada: ಜನರು ನಿನ್ನ ಅಳಿಯದ ಅಪಕೀರ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಸದಾ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಗೌರವ ಪಡೆದವನಿಗೆ ಅಪಕೀರ್ತಿಯು ಸಾವಿಗಿಂತಲೂ ಕೆಟ್ಟದ್ದು.
translation_telugu: ప్రజలు నిన్ను అప్రతిష్టకరంగా మాట్లాడుతారు. మానవంతుడికి అపకీర్తి మరణంకంటే బాధాకరం.
context_english: akīrtim—infamy; cha—and; api—also; bhūtāni—people; kathayiṣhyanti—will speak; te—of your; avyayām—everlasting; sambhāvitasya—of a respectable person; cha—and; akīrtiḥ—infamy; maraṇāt—than death; atirichyate—is greater
commentary_english: The world also will ever recount thy infamy which will survive thee for a long time. Death is really preferable to disgrace to one who has been honoured as a great hero and mighty warrior with noble qualities.
translation_kannada_source: machine-assisted — rendered from the Sanskrit, no traditional Kannada edition
commentary_kannada: ಜಗತ್ತು ಎಂದೆಂದಿಗೂ ನಿನ್ನ ಅಪಕೀರ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಅದು ನಿನ್ನನ್ನು ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲ ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಉದಾತ್ತ ಗುಣಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಮಹಾನ್ ನಾಯಕ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಬಲ ಯೋಧನಾಗಿ ಗೌರವಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟವರಿಗಿಂತ ಅವಮಾನಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಸಾವು ನಿಜವಾಗಿಯೂ ಉತ್ತಮವಾಗಿದೆ.

text:
भयाद्रणादुपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः।
येषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम्।।2.35।।
text_kannada:
ಭಯಾದ್ರಣಾದುಪರತಂ ಮಂಸ್ಯಂತೇ ತ್ವಾಂ ಮಹಾರಥಾಃ |
ಯೇಷಾಂ ಚ ತ್ವಂ ಬಹುಮತೋ ಭೂತ್ವಾ ಯಾಸ್ಯಸಿ ಲಾಘವಮ್ || ೩೫ ||
text_telugu:
భయాద్రణాదుపరతం మంస్యంతే త్వాం మహారథాః |
యేషాం చ త్వం బహుమతో భూత్వా యాస్యసి లాఘవమ్ || ౩౫ ||
transliteration:
bhayād raṇād uparataṁ mansyante tvāṁ mahā-rathāḥ
yeṣhāṁ cha tvaṁ bahu-mato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam
translation_english: The great chariot-riders will think of you as having desisted from the fight out of fear, and you will fall into disgrace before them whom you had been estimable to.
translation_kannada: ಭಯದಿಂದ ನೀನು ಯುದ್ಧದಿಂದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಸರಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಮಹಾರಥಿಗಳು ಭಾವಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಯಾರಿಗೆ ನೀನು ಗೌರವಪಾತ್ರನಾಗಿದ್ದೆಯೋ ಅವರ ಕಣ್ಣಲ್ಲೇ ನೀನು ಕೀಳಾಗುತ್ತೀಯೆ.
translation_telugu: ఈ మహారధులందరూ భయం వలన నీవు యుద్ధం నుండి పారిపోయావని అనుకుంటారు. నీ వీరత్వాన్ని గౌరవించిన వారే నిన్ను చులకనగా చూస్తారు.
context_english: bhayāt—out of fear; raṇāt—from the battlefield; uparatam—have fled; maṁsyante—will think; tvām—you; mahā-rathāḥ—warriors who could single handedly match the strength of ten thousand ordinary warriors; yeṣhām—for whom; cha—and; tvam—you; bahu-mataḥ—high esteemed; bhūtvā—having been; yāsyasi—you will loose; lāghavam—decreased in value
commentary_english: Duryodhana and others will certainly think that you have fled from the battle from fear of Karna and others, but not through compassion and reverence for elders and teachers. Duryodhana and others who have shown great esteem to you on account of your chivalry, bravery and other noble qualities, will think very lightly of you and treat you with contempt.

commentary_kannada: ನೀವು ಕರ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರರ ಭಯದಿಂದ ಯುದ್ಧದಿಂದ ಪಲಾಯನ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀರಿ ಎಂದು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರರು ಖಂಡಿತವಾಗಿ ಭಾವಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಆದರೆ ಹಿರಿಯರು ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಹಾನುಭೂತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಗೌರವದಿಂದ ಅಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಶೌರ್ಯ, ಶೌರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ಉದಾತ್ತ ಗುಣಗಳ ಕಾರಣದಿಂದಾಗಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಗೌರವವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಿದ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರರು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಲಘುವಾಗಿ ಯೋಚಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ತಿರಸ್ಕಾರದಿಂದ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

text:
अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून् वदिष्यन्ति तवाहिताः।
निन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्।।2.36।।
text_kannada:
ಅವಾಚ್ಯವಾದಾಂಶ್ಚ ಬಹೂನ್ ವದಿಷ್ಯಂತಿ ತವಾಹಿತಾಃ |
ನಿಂದಂತಸ್ತವ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯಂ ತತೋ ದುಃಖತರಂ ನು ಕಿಮ್ || ೩೬ ||
text_telugu:
అవాచ్యవాదాంశ్చ బహూన్ వదిష్యంతి తవాహితాః |
నిందంతస్తవ సామర్థ్యం తతో దుఃఖతరం ను కిమ్ || ౩౬ ||
transliteration:
avāchya-vādānśh cha bahūn vadiṣhyanti tavāhitāḥ
nindantastava sāmarthyaṁ tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim
translation_english: And your enemies will speak many indecent words while denigrating your power. What can be more painful than that?
translation_kannada: ನಿನ್ನ ಶತ್ರುಗಳು ನಿನ್ನ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ನಿಂದಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಹೇಳಬಾರದ ಅನೇಕ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ದುಃಖ ಬೇರೆ ಯಾವುದಿದೆ?
translation_telugu: నీ శత్రువులు నిన్ను గురించి పలురకాలుగా అనరాని మాటలంటారు. నీ సమర్ధతని నిందిస్తారు. అంతకన్నా ఎక్కువ దుఃఖకరమైనది ఉంటుందా?
context_english: avāchya-vādān—using harsh words; cha—and; bahūn—many; vadiṣhyanti—will say; tava—your; ahitāḥ—enemies; nindantaḥ—defame; tava—your; sāmarthyam—might; tataḥ—than that; duḥkha-taram—more painful; nu—indeed; kim—what
commentary_english: There is really no pain more unbearable and tormenting that that of slander thus incurred.

commentary_kannada: ಹೀಗೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಅಪಪ್ರಚಾರಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಅಸಹನೀಯವಾದ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾತನೆಯ ನೋವು ನಿಜವಾಗಿಯೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.

text:
हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्।
तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः।।2.37।।
text_kannada:
ಹತೋ ವಾ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಸ್ಯಸಿ ಸ್ವರ್ಗಂ ಜಿತ್ವಾ ವಾ ಭೋಕ್ಷ್ಯಸೇ ಮಹೀಮ್ |
ತಸ್ಮಾದುತ್ತಿಷ್ಠ ಕೌಂತೇಯ ಯುದ್ಧಾಯ ಕೃತನಿಶ್ಚಯಃ || ೩೭ ||
text_telugu:
హతో వా ప్రాప్స్యసి స్వర్గం జిత్వా వా భోక్ష్యసే మహీమ్ |

commentary_english: This is the Yoga of equanimity or the doctrine of poise in action. If anyone does any action with the above mental attitude or balanced state of mind he will not reap the fruits of his action. Such an action will lead to the purification of his heart and freedom from birth and death. One has to develop such a balanced state of mind through continous struggle and vigilant efforts.

text_kannada:
ಏಷಾ ತೇಽಭಿಹಿತಾ ಸಾಂಖ್ಯೇ ಬುದ್ಧಿರ್ಯೋಗೇ ತ್ವಿಮಾಂ ಶ್ರೃಣು |
ಬುದ್ಧ್ಯಾಯುಕ್ತೋ ಯಯಾ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಕರ್ಮಬಂಧಂ ಪ್ರಹಾಸ್ಯಸಿ || ೩೯ ||
text_telugu:
ఏషా తేఽభిహితా సాంఖ్యే బుద్ధిర్యోగే త్విమాం శ్రృణు |

translation_english: O Partha, this wisdom has been imparted to you from the standpoint of Self-realization. But listen to this wisdom from the standpoint of Yoga, endowed with which, you will get rid of the bondage of action.
translation_kannada: ಪಾರ್ಥನೇ, ಸಾಂಖ್ಯದ ಈ ತಿಳಿವನ್ನು ನಿನಗೆ ಹೇಳಿದೆ; ಈಗ ಯೋಗದ ತಿಳಿವನ್ನು ಕೇಳು. ಈ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದರೆ ನೀನು ಕರ್ಮದ ಬಂಧನವನ್ನು ಕಳಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೀಯೆ.
translation_telugu: ఇంతవరకు నీకు జ్ఞానాన్ని భోదించడం జరిగింది. ఇక ఈ బుద్ధి యోగాన్ని గురించి వినుము. పార్ధుడా; ఈ జ్ఞానం తోడూ ఉంటే కర్మ బంధాన్ని ఛేదిస్తావు.

commentary_english:
Lord Krishna taught Jnana (knowledge) to Arjuna till now. (Sankhya Yoga is the path of Vedanta or Jnana Yoga, which treats of the nature of the Atman or the Self and the methods to attain Selfrealisation. It is not the Sankhya philosophy of sage Kapila.) He is now giving to teach Arjuna the technie or secret of Karma Yoga endowed with which he (or anybody else) can break through the bonds of Karma.

The Karma Yogi should perform work without expectation of fruits of his actions, without the idea of agency (or the notin I do this), without attachment, after annihilating or going beyond all the pairs of opposites such as heat and cold, gain and loss, victoyr and defeat, etc. Dharma and Adharma, or merit and demerit will not touch that Karma Yogi who works without attachment and egoism. The Karma Yogi consecrates all his works and their fruits as offerings unto the Lord (Isvararpanam) and thus obtains the grace of the Lord (Isvaraprasada).

text:
नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते।
स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात्।।2.40।।
text_kannada:
ನೇಹಾಭಿಕ್ರಮನಾಶೋಽಸ್ತಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯವಾಯೋ ನ ವಿದ್ಯತೇ |
ಸ್ವಲ್ಪಮಪ್ಯಸ್ಯ ಧರ್ಮಸ್ಯ ತ್ರಾಯತೇ ಮಹತೋ ಭಯಾತ್ || ೪೦ ||
text_telugu:
నేహాభిక్రమనాశోఽస్తి ప్రత్యవాయో న విద్యతే |
స్వల్పమప్యస్య ధర్మస్య త్రాయతే మహతో భయాత్ || ౪౦ ||
transliteration:
nehābhikrama-nāśho ’sti pratyavāyo na vidyate
svalpam apyasya dharmasya trāyate mahato bhayāt
translation_english: Here, there is no waste of effort; nor is there any harm. Even a little of this righteousness saves one from great fear.
translation_kannada: ಈ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿದ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವು ವ್ಯರ್ಥವಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಯಾವ ಹಾನಿಯೂ ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಈ ಧರ್ಮದ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಆಚರಣೆಯೂ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಭಯದಿಂದ ಕಾಪಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
translation_telugu: ఇందులో ఆరంభం నిష్ఫలం కావడం కానీ విపరీత ఫలితాలు కానీ ఉండవు. ఈ ధర్మం ఏకొంచం ఆచరించినా భయం నుండి రక్షిస్తుంది.
context_english: na—not; iha—in this; abhikrama—efforts; nāśhaḥ—loss; asti—there is; pratyavāyaḥ—adverse result; na—not; vidyate—is; su-alpam—a little; api—even; asya—of this; dharmasya—occupation; trāyate—saves; mahataḥ—from great; bhayāt—danger
commentary_english:
If a religious ceremony is left uncompleted, it is a wastage as the performer cannot realise the fruits. But it is not so in the case of Karma Yoga because every action causes immediate purification of the heart.In agriculture there is uncertainty. The farmer may till the land, plough and sow the seed but he may not get a crop if there is no rain. This is not so in Karma Yoga. There is no uncertainty at all.

Further, there is no chance of any harm coming out of it. In the case of medical treatment great harm will result from the doctors injudicious treatment if he uses a wrong medicine. But it is not so in the case of Karma Yoga. Anything done, however little it may be, in this path of Yoga, the Yoga of action, saves one from great fear of being caught in the wheel of birth and death. Lord Krishna here extols Karma Yoga in order to create interest in Arjuna in this Yoga.

commentary_kannada:
ಒಂದು ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಸಮಾರಂಭವನ್ನು ಅಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಬಿಟ್ಟರೆ, ಅದು ವ್ಯರ್ಥವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಕಲಾವಿದನಿಗೆ ಅದರ ಫಲವನ್ನು ಅರಿತುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೆ ಕರ್ಮ ಯೋಗದ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಗಲ್ಲ ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯೂ ಹೃದಯದ ತಕ್ಷಣದ ಶುದ್ಧೀಕರಣವನ್ನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೃಷಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅನಿಶ್ಚಿತತೆ ಇದೆ. ರೈತನು ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು, ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಮತ್ತು ಬೀಜವನ್ನು ಬಿತ್ತಬಹುದು, ಆದರೆ ಮಳೆ ಬರದಿದ್ದರೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆ ಸಿಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಕರ್ಮ ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಗಲ್ಲ. ಯಾವುದೇ ರೀತಿಯ ಅನಿಶ್ಚಿತತೆಯೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.

ಇದಲ್ಲದೆ, ಅದರಿಂದ ಯಾವುದೇ ಹಾನಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಯಿಲ್ಲ. ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ, ಆತ ತಪ್ಪು ಔಷಧಿಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿದರೆ, ವೈದ್ಯರ ಅನುಚಿತ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯಿಂದ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಹಾನಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಕರ್ಮ ಯೋಗದ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಗಲ್ಲ. ಯೋಗದ ಈ ಮಾರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಏನೇ ಮಾಡಿದರೂ, ಅದು ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾದರೂ, ಕರ್ಮಯೋಗವು ಜನ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಮರಣದ ಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಹಾಕಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಭಯದಿಂದ ಒಬ್ಬರನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಅರ್ಜುನನಲ್ಲಿ ಆಸಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುವ ಸಲುವಾಗಿ ಭಗವಾನ್ ಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ಮ ಯೋಗವನ್ನು ಸ್ತುತಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.

text:
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन।
बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम्।।2.41।।
text_kannada:
ವ್ಯವಸಾಯಾತ್ಮಿಕಾ ಬುದ್ಧಿರೇಕೇಹ ಕುರುನಂದನ |
ಬಹುಶಾಖಾ ಹ್ಯನಂತಾಶ್ಚ ಬುದ್ಧಯೋಽವ್ಯವಸಾಯಿನಾಮ್ || ೪೧ ||
text_telugu:
వ్యవసాయాత్మికా బుద్ధిరేకేహ కురునందన |
బహుశాఖా హ్యనంతాశ్చ బుద్ధయోఽవ్యవసాయినామ్ || ౪౧ ||
transliteration:
vyavasāyātmikā buddhir ekeha kuru-nandana
bahu-śhākhā hyanantāśh cha buddhayo ’vyavasāyinām
translation_english: O scion of the Kuru dynasty, in this there is a single, one-pointed conviction. The thoughts of the irresolute ones, however, have many branches indeed and are innumerable.
translation_kannada: ಕುರುವಂಶದ ಕುಡಿಯೇ, ಈ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಶ್ಚಯದಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯು ಒಂದೇ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಶ್ಚಯವಿಲ್ಲದವರ ಬುದ್ಧಿಗಳು ಅನೇಕ ಕವಲುಗಳುಳ್ಳವು, ಕೊನೆಯಿಲ್ಲದವು.
translation_telugu: కురునందనా! ఇక్కడ నిశ్చయంతో కూడిన బుద్ధి ఏకాగ్రంగా ఒకే విధంగా ఉంటుంది. నిశ్చయం లేనివారికి బుద్ధులు అనేక శాఖలుగా చీలి అసంఖ్యాకంగా ఉంటాయి.
context_english: vyavasāya-ātmikā—resolute; buddhiḥ—intellect; ekā—single; iha—on this path; kuru-nandana—descendent of the Kurus; bahu-śhākhāḥ—many-branched; hi—indeed; anantāḥ—endless; cha—also; buddhayaḥ—intellect; avyavasāyinām—of the irresolute
commentary_english:
Here, in this path to Bliss there is only one thought of a resolute nature there is singleminded determination. This single thought arises from the right source of knowledge. The student of Yoga collects all the dissipated rays of the mind. He gathers all of them through discrimination, dispassion and concentration. He is free from wavering or vacillation of the mind.The worldlyminded man who is suck in the mire of Samsara has no singleminded determination.

He entertains countless thoughts. His mind is always unsteady and vacillating.If thoughts cease? Samsara also ceases. Mind generates endless thoughts and this world comes into being. Thoughts, and names and forms are inseparable. If the thoughts are controlled, the mind is controlled and the Yogi is liberated.

commentary_kannada:
ಇಲ್ಲಿ, ಆನಂದದ ಈ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ದೃಢನಿಶ್ಚಯದ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯ ಒಂದೇ ಒಂದು ಆಲೋಚನೆ ಇದೆ, ಏಕಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಸಂಕಲ್ಪವಿದೆ. ಈ ಏಕೈಕ ಚಿಂತನೆಯು ಜ್ಞಾನದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮೂಲದಿಂದ ಉದ್ಭವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಯೋಗದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಹರಡಿದ ಕಿರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವರು ತಾರತಮ್ಯ, ನಿರಾಸಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಏಕಾಗ್ರತೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಅವರೆಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಒಟ್ಟುಗೂಡಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವನು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಅಸ್ಥಿರತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಅಸ್ಥಿರತೆಯಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತನಾಗಿರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸಂಸಾರದ ಕೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೀರಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಲೌಕಿಕ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗೆ ಏಕಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಸಂಕಲ್ಪವಿಲ್ಲ.

ಅವರು ಲೆಕ್ಕವಿಲ್ಲದಷ್ಟು ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮನರಂಜಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಅಸ್ಥಿರ ಮತ್ತು ಅಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳು ನಿಂತುಹೋದರೆ? ಸಂಸಾರವೂ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ. ಮನಸ್ಸು ಅಂತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲದ ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಈ ಜಗತ್ತು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳು, ಹೆಸರುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ರೂಪಗಳು ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಲಾಗದವು. ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಿದರೆ, ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯೋಗಿಯು ಮುಕ್ತನಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.

text:
यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्चितः।
वेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः।।2.42।।
text_kannada:
ಯಾಮಿಮಾಂ ಪುಷ್ಪಿತಾಂ ವಾಚಂ ಪ್ರವದಂತ್ಯವಿಪಶ್ಚಿತಃ |
ವೇದವಾದರತಾಃ ಪಾರ್ಥ ನಾನ್ಯದಸ್ತೀತಿ ವಾದಿನಃ || ೪೨ ||
text_telugu:
యామిమాం పుష్పితాం వాచం ప్రవదంత్యవిపశ్చితః |
వేదవాదరతాః పార్థ నాన్యదస్తీతి వాదినః || ౪౨ ||
transliteration:
yāmimāṁ puṣhpitāṁ vāchaṁ pravadanty-avipaśhchitaḥ
veda-vāda-ratāḥ pārtha nānyad astīti vādinaḥ
kāmātmānaḥ swarga-parā janma-karma-phala-pradām
kriyā-viśheṣha-bahulāṁ bhogaiśhwarya-gatiṁ prati
translation_english: O son of Prtha, those undiscerning people who utter this flowery talk, which promises birth as a result of rites and duties, and is full of various special rites meant for the attainment of enjoyment and affluence, remain engrossed in the utterances of the Vedas and declare that nothing else exists; their minds are full of desires and they have heaven as their goal.
translation_kannada: ಪಾರ್ಥನೇ, ವೇದದ ಮಾತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಆಸಕ್ತರಾದ, ಇದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಬೇರೇನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ ಎನ್ನುವ ಅಲ್ಪಜ್ಞರು ಆಕರ್ಷಕವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುವ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
translation_telugu: అర్జునా; అజ్ఞానులు వేద వాక్యాలలో ఆసక్తి ఉన్న వాళ్ళు స్వర్గం కంటే వేరేది లేదని పువ్వుల్లాంటి మధురమైన ఈ మాటని చెప్తారు.
context_english:
yām imām—all these; puṣhpitām—flowery; vācham—words; pravadanti—speak; avipaśhchitaḥ—those with limited understanding; veda-vāda-ratāḥ—attached to the flowery words of the Vedas; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; na anyat—no other; asti—is; iti—thus; vādinaḥ—advocate;
kāma-ātmānaḥ—desirous of sensual pleasure; swarga-parāḥ—aiming to achieve the heavenly planets; janma-karma-phala—high birth and fruitive results; pradāṁ—awarding; kriyā-viśheṣha—pompous ritualistic ceremonies; bahulām—various; bhoga—gratification; aiśhwarya—luxury; gatim—progress; prati—toward
commentary_english:
Unwise people who are lacking in discrimination lay great stress upon the Karma Kanda or the ritualistic portion of the Vedas, which lays down specific rules for specific actions for,the attainment of specific fruits and ectol these actions and rewards unduly. They are highly enamoured of such Vedic passages which prescribe ways for the attainment of heavenly enjoyments.

They say that there is nothing else beyond the sensual enjoyments in Svarga (heaven) which can be obtained by performing the rites of the Karma Kanda of the Vedas.There are two main divisions of the Vedas -- Karma Kanda (the section dealing with action) and Jnana Kanda (the section dealing with knowledge). The Karma Kanda comprises the Brahmanas and the Samhitas. This is the authority for the Purvamimamsa school founded by Jaimini.

The followers of this school deal with rituals and prescribe many of them for attaining enjoyments and power here and happiness in heaven. They regard this as the ultimate object of human existence. Ordinary people are attracted by their panegyrics. The Jnana Kanda comprises the Aranyakas and the Upanishads which deal with the nature of Brahman or the Supreme Self.Life in heaven is also transitory.

After the fruits of the good actions are exhausted, one has to come back to this earthplane. Liberatio or Moksha can only be attained by knowledge of the Self but not by performing a thousand and one sacrifices.Lord Krishna assigns a comparatively inferior position to the doctrine of the Mimamsakas of performing Vedic sacrifices for obtaining heaven, power and lordship in this world as they cannot give us final liberation.

commentary_kannada:
ತಾರತಮ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊರತೆಯಿರುವ ಅವಿವೇಕಿ ಜನರು ಕರ್ಮ ಕಾಂಡ ಅಥವಾ ವೇದಗಳ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಒತ್ತು ನೀಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಇದು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಫಲಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಈ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಗಳನ್ನು ಅನಗತ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಸಾಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ವರ್ಗೀಯ ಆನಂದಗಳ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವ ಅಂತಹ ವೈದಿಕ ಭಾಗಗಳಿಂದ ಅವರು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಆಕರ್ಷಿತರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

ವೇದಗಳ ಕರ್ಮ ಕಾಂಡದ ವಿಧಿಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದಾದ ಸ್ವರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ (ಸ್ವರ್ಗ) ಇಂದ್ರಿಯ ಆನಂದಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿ ಬೇರೇನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಅವರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ವೇದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳಿವೆ-ಕರ್ಮ ಕಾಂಡ (ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ವ್ಯವಹರಿಸುವ ವಿಭಾಗ) ಮತ್ತು ಜ್ಞಾನ ಕಾಂಡ (ಜ್ಞಾನದೊಂದಿಗೆ ವ್ಯವಹರಿಸುವ ವಿಭಾಗ). ಕರ್ಮ ಕಾಂಡವು ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಹಿತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಇದು ಜೈಮಿನಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದ ಪೂರ್ವಮಿಮಾಂಶ ಪಂಥದ ಅಧಿಕಾರವಾಗಿದೆ.

ಈ ಪಂಥದ ಅನುಯಾಯಿಗಳು ಆಚರಣೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ವ್ಯವಹರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವನ್ನು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಆನಂದ ಮತ್ತು ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತೋಷವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಲು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವರು ಇದನ್ನು ಮಾನವ ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದ ಅಂತಿಮ ಉದ್ದೇಶವೆಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಜನರು ಅವರ ಪನೇಗ್ರಿಕ್ಸ್ನಿಂದ ಆಕರ್ಷಿತರಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಜ್ಞಾನ ಕಾಂಡವು ಆರಣ್ಯಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಉಪನಿಷತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದ್ದು, ಅವು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಅಥವಾ ಪರಮಾತ್ಮನ ಸ್ವರೂಪದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವ್ಯವಹರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸ್ವರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿನ ಜೀವನವೂ ಸಹ ಕ್ಷಣಿಕವಾಗಿದೆ.

ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳ ಫಲವು ಖಾಲಿಯಾದ ನಂತರ, ಒಬ್ಬರು ಈ ಭೂಪ್ರದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ಮೋಕ್ಷವನ್ನು ಕೇವಲ ಆತ್ಮಜ್ಞಾನದಿಂದ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಾಧಿಸಬಹುದು, ಆದರೆ ಸಾವಿರದ ಒಂದು ಯಜ್ಞಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾಧಿಸಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಭಗವಾನ್ ಕೃಷ್ಣನು ನಮಗೆ ಅಂತಿಮ ವಿಮೋಚನೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗದ ಕಾರಣ ಈ ಜಗತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವರ್ಗ, ಶಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಭುತ್ವವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಲು ವೈದಿಕ ಯಜ್ಞಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವ ಮೀಮಾಂಸಕರ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತಕ್ಕೆ ತುಲನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ಕೆಳಮಟ್ಟದ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ನಿಯೋಜಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.

text:
कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम्।
क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति।।2.43।।
text_kannada:
ಕಾಮಾತ್ಮಾನಃ ಸ್ವರ್ಗಪರಾ ಜನ್ಮಕರ್ಮಫಲಪ್ರದಾಮ್ |
ಕ್ರಿಯಾವಿಶೇಷಬಹುಲಾಂ ಭೋಗೈಶ್ವರ್ಯಗತಿಂ ಪ್ರತಿ || ೪೩ ||
text_telugu:
కామాత్మానః స్వర్గపరా జన్మకర్మఫలప్రదామ్ |
క్రియావిశేషబహులాం భోగైశ్వర్యగతిం ప్రతి || ౪౩ ||
transliteration:
kāmātmānaḥ svarga-parā
janma-karma-phala-pradām
kriyā-viśeṣa-bahulāṁ
bhogaiśvarya-gatiṁ prati
translation_english: O son of Prtha, those undiscerning people who utter this flowery talk, which promises birth as a result of rites and duties, and is full of various special rites meant for the attainment of enjoyment and affluence, remain engrossed in the utterances of the Vedas and declare that nothing else exists; their minds are full of desires and they have heaven as their goal.
translation_kannada: ಬಯಕೆಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದ, ಸ್ವರ್ಗವನ್ನೇ ಗುರಿಯಾಗಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡ ಅವರ ಆ ಮಾತು ಜನ್ಮವನ್ನೂ ಕರ್ಮಫಲವನ್ನೂ ಕೊಡುವಂಥದ್ದು; ಭೋಗ ಮತ್ತು ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಬಗೆಬಗೆಯ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಳುವಂಥದ್ದು.
translation_telugu: కోరికలతో నిండినవాళ్ళూ, స్వర్గమే లక్ష్యంగా పెట్టుకున్న వాళ్ళూ, జన్మలనూ, స్వర్గాదులను ఇచ్చేవి, వాటిని సాధించే అనేక కర్మ విశేషాలతో నిండినవీ, భోగైస్వర్యాలను కలిగించేవి అయిన పువ్వుల్లాంటి మధురమైన వచనాలను చెప్తారు.
context_english: kāmaātmānaḥ—desirous of sense gratification; svarga-parāḥ—aiming to achieve heavenly planets; janma-karma-phala-pradām—resulting in fruitive action, good birth, etc.; kriyā-viśeṣa—pompous ceremonies; bahulām—various; bhoga—sense enjoyment; aiśvarya—opulence; gatim—progress; prati—towards.
commentary_english:
Partha, O son of Prtha; those devoid of one-pointed conviction, who pravadanti, utter; imam, this; yam puspitam vacam, flowery talk, which is going to be stated, which is beautiful like a tree in bloom, pleasant to hear, and appears to be (meaningful) sentences [Sentences that can be called really meaningful are only those that reveal the self.-Tr.]; who are they, they are avipascitah, people who are undiscerning, of poor intellect, i.e. non-discriminating; veda-vada-ratah, who remain engrossed in the utterances of the Vedas, in the Vedic sentences which reveal many panegyrics, fruits of action and their means; and vadinah, who declare, are apt tosay; iti, that; na anyat, nothing else [God, Liberation, etc.]; asti, exists, apart from the rites and duties conducive to such results as attainment of heaven etc. And they are kamatmanah, have their minds full of desires, i.e. they are swayed by desires, they are, by nature, full of desires; (and) svarga-parah, have heaven as the goal.

Those who accept heaven (svarga) as the supreme (para) human goal, to whom heaven is the highest, are svarga-parah. They utter that speech ( this is supplied to construct the sentence ) which janma-karma-phala-pradam, promises birth as a result of rites and duties. The result (phala) of rites and duties (karma) is karma-phala. Birth (janma) itself is the karma-phala. That (speech) which promises this is janma-karma-phala-prada. (This speech) is kriya-visesa-bahulam, full of various special rites; bhoga-aisvarya-gatim-prati, for the attainment of enjoyment and affluence.

Special (visesa) rites (kriya) are kriya-visesah. The speech that is full (bahula) of these, the speech by which that is full (bahula) of these, the speech by which these, viz objects such as heaven, animals and sons, are revealed plentifully, is kriya-visesa-bahula. Bhoga, enjoyment, and aisvarya, affluence, are bhoga-aisvarya. Their attainment (gatih) is bhoga-aisvarya-gatih. (They utter a speech) that is full of the specialized rites, prati, meant for that (attainment). The fools who utter that speech move in the cycle of transmigration. This is the idea.

commentary_kannada:
ಪಾರ್ಥ, ಓ ಪಾರ್ಥನ ಮಗನೇ; ಏಕ-ಬಿಂದುವಿನ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಇಲ್ಲದವರು, ಯಾರು ಪ್ರವದಂತಿ, ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಇಮಾಮ್, ಇದು; ಯಾಮ್ ಪುಷ್ಪಿತಮ್ ವಾಕಮ್, ಹೂವಿನ ಮಾತು, ಇದು ಹೇಳಲ್ಪಡಲಿದೆ, ಇದು ಅರಳುತ್ತಿರುವ ಮರದಂತೆ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿದೆ, ಕೇಳಲು ಆಹ್ಲಾದಕರವಾಗಿದೆ, ಮತ್ತು (ಅರ್ಥಪೂರ್ಣ) ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ [ನಿಜವಾಗಿಯೂ ಅರ್ಥಪೂರ್ಣವೆಂದು ಕರೆಯಬಹುದಾದ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳು ಮಾತ್ರ ಆತ್ಮವನ್ನು ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.-Tr.]; ಅವರು ಯಾರು, ಅವರು ಅವ್ಯಕ್ತರು, ಕಳಪೆ ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯ ಜನರು, ಅಂದರೆ ತಾರತಮ್ಯರಹಿತರು; ವೇದಗಳ ಉಚ್ಚಾರಣೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿರುವ ವೇದ-ವಾದ-ರಾತ, ಅನೇಕ ಪನೇಗ್ರಿಕ್ಸ್, ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ಫಲಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸುವ ವೈದಿಕ ವಾಕ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ; ಮತ್ತು ವಾದಿನ, ಹೇಳಲು ಯೋಗ್ಯರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಎಂದು ಘೋಷಿಸುವವರು; ಇತಿ, ಅಂದರೆ; ನ ಅನ್ಯತ್, ಬೇರೆ ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ (ದೇವರು, ವಿಮೋಚನೆ, ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ); ಅಸ್ತಿಯು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿದೆ, ಸ್ವರ್ಗದ ಸಾಧನೆಯಂತಹ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನುಕೂಲಕರವಾದ ವಿಧಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕರ್ತವ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊರತುಪಡಿಸಿ. ಮತ್ತು ಅವರು ಕಾಮತ್ಮನಹ್, ಅವರ ಮನಸ್ಸುಗಳು ಬಯಕೆಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿವೆ, ಅಂದರೆ. ಅವರು ಬಯಕೆಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರಭಾವಿತರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ, ಅವು ಸ್ವಭಾವತಃ, ಬಯಕೆಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿವೆ; (ಸ್ವರ್ಗ) ಮತ್ತು (ಸ್ವರ್ಗ) ಗುರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.

ಸ್ವರ್ಗವನ್ನು (ಸ್ವರ್ಗ) ಸರ್ವೋಚ್ಚ (ಪ್ಯಾರಾ) ಮಾನವ ಗುರಿಯಾಗಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುವವರು, ಯಾರಿಗೆ ಸ್ವರ್ಗವು ಅತ್ಯುನ್ನತವಾದುದೋ, ಅವರು ಸ್ವರ್ಗ-ಪರಾಹ್. ಅವರು ಆ ಭಾಷಣವನ್ನು ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ (ಇದನ್ನು ವಾಕ್ಯವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ಒದಗಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ) ಇದು ಜನ್ಮ-ಕರ್ಮ-ಫಲ-ಪ್ರದಾಮ್, ಆಚರಣೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕರ್ತವ್ಯಗಳ ಪರಿಣಾಮವಾಗಿ ಜನನದ ಭರವಸೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಚರಣೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕರ್ತವ್ಯಗಳ (ಕರ್ಮ) ಫಲಿತಾಂಶವು (ಫಲ) ಕರ್ಮ-ಫಲವಾಗಿದೆ. ಜನ್ಮವೇ (ಜನ್ಮ) ಕರ್ಮ-ಫಲವಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಭರವಸೆ ನೀಡುವ (ಮಾತು) ಅದು ಜನ್ಮ-ಕರ್ಮ-ಫಲ-ಪ್ರದ. (ಈ ಭಾಷಣ) ವಿವಿಧ ವಿಶೇಷ ವಿಧಿಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದ ಕ್ರಿಯಾ-ವಿಸೇಸ-ಬಾಹುಲಂ ಆಗಿದೆ; ಭೋಗ-ಐಸ್ವರ್ಯ-ಗತಿಮ್-ಪ್ರತಿ, ಆನಂದ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿಯ ಸಾಧನೆಗಾಗಿ.

ವಿಶೇಷ (ವಿಸೇಸ) ವಿಧಿಗಳು (ಕ್ರಿಯಾ) ಕ್ರಿಯಾ-ವಿಸೇಸಹ್ಗಳಾಗಿವೆ. ಇವುಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದ ಮಾತು (ಬಾಹುಲಾ), ಇವುಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದ ಮಾತು (ಬಾಹುಲಾ), ಇವುಗಳಿಂದ, ಅಂದರೆ ಸ್ವರ್ಗ, ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪುತ್ರರಂತಹ ವಸ್ತುಗಳು ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಕಟವಾಗುವ ಮಾತು, ಕ್ರಿಯಾ-ವಿಸೇಸ-ಬಾಹುಲಾ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಭೋಗ, ಆನಂದ ಮತ್ತು ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯ, ಸಂಪತ್ತು, ಇವು ಭೋಗ-ಐಸ್ವರ್ಯಗಳಾಗಿವೆ. ಅವರ ಸಾಧನೆಯು (ಗತಿಹ್) ಭೋಗ-ಐಸ್ವರ್ಯ-ಗತಿಹ್ ಆಗಿದೆ. (ಅವರು ಒಂದು ಭಾಷಣವನ್ನು ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ) ಅದು ವಿಶೇಷ ವಿಧಿಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿರುತ್ತದೆ, ಪ್ರತಿ, ಅದಕ್ಕಾಗಿಯೇ (ಸಾಧನೆ). ಆ ಮಾತನ್ನು ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸುವ ಮೂರ್ಖರು ವಲಸೆಯ ಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇದು ಕಲ್ಪನೆ.

text:
भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानां तयापहृतचेतसाम्।
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते।।2.44।।
text_kannada:
ಭೋಗೈಶ್ವರ್ಯಪ್ರಸಕ್ತಾನಾಂ ತಯಾಪಹೃತಚೇತಸಾಮ್ |
ವ್ಯವಸಾಯಾತ್ಮಿಕಾ ಬುದ್ಧಿಃ ಸಮಾಧೌ ನ ವಿಧೀಯತೇ || ೪೪ ||
text_telugu:
భోగైశ్వర్యప్రసక్తానాం తయాపహృతచేతసామ్ |
వ్యవసాయాత్మికా బుద్ధిః సమాధౌ న విధీయతే || ౪౪ ||
transliteration:
bhogaiśwvarya-prasaktānāṁ tayāpahṛita-chetasām
vyavasāyātmikā buddhiḥ samādhau na vidhīyate
translation_english: One-pointed conviction does not become established in the minds of those who delight in enjoyment and affluence, and whose intellects are carried away by it.
translation_kannada: ಭೋಗ ಮತ್ತು ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಟಿಕೊಂಡ, ಆ ಮಾತಿನಿಂದ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡವರಿಗೆ ನಿಶ್ಚಯದಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯು ಸಮಾಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲೆಗೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
translation_telugu: భోగైశ్వర్యాలలో తగుల్కొని ఆ మధుర వాక్యాలకు లోబడి పోయినవారికి అంతఃకరణలో నిశ్ఛయ జ్ఞానం ఏర్పడదు
context_english: bhoga—gratification; aiśhwarya—luxury; prasaktānām—whose minds are deeply attached; tayā—by that; apahṛita-chetasām—bewildered in intellect; vyavasāya-ātmikā—resolute; buddhiḥ—intellect; samādhau—fulfilment; na—never; vidhīyate—occurs
commentary_english: Those who cling to pleasure and power cannot have steadiness of mind. They cannot concentrate or meditate. They are ever busy in planning projects for the acquisition of wealth and power. Their minds are ever restless. They have no poised understanding.

text:
त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन।
निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान्।।2.45।।
text_kannada:
ತ್ರೈಗುಣ್ಯವಿಷಯಾ ವೇದಾ ನಿಸ್ತ್ರೈಗುಣ್ಯೋ ಭವಾರ್ಜುನ |
ನಿರ್ದ್ವಂದ್ವೋ ನಿತ್ಯಸತ್ತ್ವಸ್ಥೋ ನಿರ್ಯೋಗಕ್ಷೇಮ ಆತ್ಮವಾನ್ || ೪೫ ||
text_telugu:
త్రైగుణ్యవిషయా వేదా నిస్త్రైగుణ్యో భవార్జున |
నిర్ద్వంద్వో నిత్యసత్త్వస్థో నిర్యోగక్షేమ ఆత్మవాన్ || ౪౫ ||
transliteration:
trai-guṇya-viṣhayā vedā nistrai-guṇyo bhavārjuna
nirdvandvo nitya-sattva-stho niryoga-kṣhema ātmavān
translation_english: O Arjuna, the Vedas [Meaning only the portion dealing with rites and duties (karma-kanda).] have the three qualities as their object. You become free from worldliness, free from the pairs of duality, ever-poised in the quality of sattva, without (desire for) acquisition and protection, and self-collected.
translation_kannada: ಅರ್ಜುನಾ, ವೇದಗಳು ಮೂರು ಗುಣಗಳ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತವೆ; ನೀನು ಆ ಗುಣಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿದವನಾಗು. ದ್ವಂದ್ವಗಳಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತನಾಗಿ, ಸದಾ ಸತ್ತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲೆಸಿ, ಗಳಿಕೆ ಕಾಪಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಚಿಂತೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಆತ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲೆಗೊಳ್ಳು.
translation_telugu: అర్జునా! వేదాలు త్రిగుణాత్మకమైన సంసార విషయాలకు చెందినవి నీవు వాటికి అతీతుడైనై, సుఖదుఃఖాది ద్వందాలని వదిలి, నిత్యముశుద్ధ సత్వములో నిలిచి, యోగక్షేమాలను నర్జించి(వదిలి), ఆత్మజ్ఞానివి కా.
context_english: trai-guṇya—of the three modes of material nature; viṣhayāḥ—subject matter; vedāḥ—Vedic scriptures; nistrai-guṇyaḥ—above the three modes of material nature, transcendental; bhava—be; arjuna—Arjun; nirdvandvaḥ—free from dualities; nitya-sattva-sthaḥ—eternally fixed in truth; niryoga-kṣhemaḥ—unconcerned about gain and preservation; ātma-vān—situated in the self
commentary_english:
Guna means attribute or quality. It is substance as well as quality. Nature (Prakriti) is made up of three Gunas, viz.? Sattva (purity, light or harmony)? Rajas (passion or motion) and Tamas (darkness or inertia). The pairs of opposites are heat and cold, pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat, honour and dishonour, praise and censure.

He who is anxious about new acuqisitions or about the preservation of his old possessions cannot have peace of mind. He is ever restless. He cannot concentrate or meditate on the Self. He cannot practise virtue. Therefore? Lord Krishna advises Arjuna that he should be free from the thought of acquisition and preservation of things. (Cf.IX.20?21).

commentary_kannada:
ಗುಣ ಎಂದರೆ ಗುಣ ಅಥವಾ ಗುಣ ಎಂದರ್ಥ. ಇದು ವಸ್ತುವಿನ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟವೂ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಪ್ರಕೃತಿ (ಪ್ರಕೃತಿ) ಮೂರು ಗುಣಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದೆ. ಸತ್ವ (ಶುದ್ಧತೆ, ಬೆಳಕು ಅಥವಾ ಸಾಮರಸ್ಯ)? ರಾಜರು (ಭಾವೋದ್ರೇಕ ಅಥವಾ ಚಲನೆ) ಮತ್ತು ತಮರು (ಕತ್ತಲೆ ಅಥವಾ ಜಡತ್ವ). ಉಷ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಶೀತ, ಸಂತೋಷ ಮತ್ತು ನೋವು, ಲಾಭ ಮತ್ತು ನಷ್ಟ, ಗೆಲುವು ಮತ್ತು ಸೋಲು, ಗೌರವ ಮತ್ತು ಅವಮಾನ, ಹೊಗಳಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಖಂಡನೆಗಳು ವಿರುದ್ಧವಾದ ಜೋಡಿಗಳಾಗಿವೆ.

ಹೊಸ ಸಾಧನೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಥವಾ ತನ್ನ ಹಳೆಯ ಆಸ್ತಿಯ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಚಿಂತಿತರಾಗಿರುವವರಿಗೆ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಶಾಂತಿ ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆತ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಪ್ರಕ್ಷುಬ್ಧನಾಗಿರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆತನಿಗೆ ಆತ್ಮದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗಮನ ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಕರಿಸಲು ಅಥವಾ ಧ್ಯಾನ ಮಾಡಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಆತನು ಸದ್ಗುಣವನ್ನು ಆಚರಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ? ಅರ್ಜುನನು ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಸ್ವಾಧೀನ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣೆಯ ಆಲೋಚನೆಯಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತನಾಗಿರಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಭಗವಾನ್ ಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಅರ್ಜುನನಿಗೆ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. (Cf.IX.20?21).

text:
यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः संप्लुतोदके।
तावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः।।2.46।।
text_kannada:
ಯಾವಾನರ್ಥ ಉದಪಾನೇ ಸರ್ವತಃ ಸಂಪ್ಲುತೋದಕೇ |
ತಾವಾನ್ಸರ್ವೇಷು ವೇದೇಷು ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಸ್ಯ ವಿಜಾನತಃ || ೪೬ ||
text_telugu:
యావానర్థ ఉదపానే సర్వతః సంప్లుతోదకే |
తావాన్సర్వేషు వేదేషు బ్రాహ్మణస్య విజానతః || ౪౬ ||
transliteration:
yāvān artha udapāne sarvataḥ samplutodake
tāvānsarveṣhu vedeṣhu brāhmaṇasya vijānataḥ
translation_english: A Brahmana with realization has that much utility in all the Vedas as a person has in a well when there is a flood all around.
translation_kannada: ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ನೀರು ತುಂಬಿ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತಿರುವಾಗ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಬಾವಿಯಿಂದ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಯೋಜನವೋ, ತತ್ತ್ವವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣನಿಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ವೇದಗಳಿಂದಲೂ ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನ.
translation_telugu: అంతటా జలం పొంగుతున్నప్పుడు జలకాల శాల ఉపయోగం ఎంతవరకో అనుభవజ్ఞుడైన బ్రహ్మజ్ఞానికి అన్ని వేదాల ఉపయోగం అంతవరకే.
context_english: yāvān—whatever; arthaḥ—purpose; uda-pāne—a well of water; sarvataḥ—in all respects; sampluta-udake—by a large lake; tāvān—that many; sarveṣhu—in all; vedeṣhu—Vedas; brāhmaṇasya—one who realizes the Absolute Truth; vijānataḥ—who is in complete knowledge
commentary_english: Only for a sage who has realised the Self, the Vedas are of no use, because he is in possession of the infinite knowledge of the Self. This does not, however, mean that the Vedas are useless. They are useful for the neophytes or the aspirants who have just started on the spiritual path.All the transient pleasures derivable from the proper performance of all actions enjoined in the Vedas are comprehended in the infinite bliss of Selfknowledge.

commentary_kannada: ಆತ್ಮವನ್ನು ಅರಿತ ಋಷಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ವೇದಗಳಿಂದ ಯಾವುದೇ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನವಿಲ್ಲ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಆತನು ಆತ್ಮದ ಅನಂತ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಆದಾಗ್ಯೂ, ಇದರರ್ಥ ವೇದಗಳು ನಿಷ್ಪ್ರಯೋಜಕವಾಗಿವೆ ಎಂದಲ್ಲ. ಅವರು ನಿಯೋಫೈಟ್ಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಥವಾ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿರುವ ಆಕಾಂಕ್ಷಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ವೇದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಆಜ್ಞಾಪಿಸಲಾದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳ ಸರಿಯಾದ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯಿಂದ ಉತ್ಪತ್ತಿಯಾಗುವ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಸಂತೋಷಗಳು ಆತ್ಮಜ್ಞಾನದ ಅನಂತ ಆನಂದದಲ್ಲಿ ಗ್ರಹಿಸಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತವೆ.

text:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि।।2.47।।
text_kannada:
ಕರ್ಮಣ್ಯೇವಾಧಿಕಾರಸ್ತೇ ಮಾ ಫಲೇಷು ಕದಾಚನ |
ಮಾ ಕರ್ಮಫಲಹೇತೂರ್ಭೂರ್ಮಾ ತೇ ಸಂಗೋಽಸ್ತ್ವಕರ್ಮಣಿ || ೪೭ ||
text_telugu:
కర్మణ్యేవాధికారస్తే మా ఫలేషు కదాచన |
మా కర్మఫలహేతూర్భూర్మా తే సంగోఽస్త్వకర్మణి || ౪౭ ||
transliteration:
karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣhu kadāchana
mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo ’stvakarmaṇi
translation_english: Your right is only to act, not to the results. Do not be the cause of the results of action. Do not have any inclination towards inaction.
translation_kannada: ಕರ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ನಿನಗೆ ಅಧಿಕಾರವಿದೆ, ಅದರ ಫಲಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಂದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಕರ್ಮಫಲಕ್ಕೆ ನೀನು ಕಾರಣನಾಗಬೇಡ, ಕರ್ಮ ಮಾಡದಿರುವುದರಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ನಿನಗೆ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಬೇಡ.
translation_telugu: కర్మలు చేయడంలోనే నీకు అధికారం ఉన్నది. కర్మ ఫలాలపైన ఎప్పుడూ లేదు. కర్మ ఫలానికి కారకుడివి కావద్దు. అలాగని కర్మలు చెయ్యడము మానవద్దు.
context_english: karmaṇi—in prescribed duties; eva—only; adhikāraḥ—right; te—your; mā—not; phaleṣhu—in the fruits; kadāchana—at any time; mā—never; karma-phala—results of the activities; hetuḥ—cause; bhūḥ—be; mā—not; te—your; saṅgaḥ—attachment; astu—must be; akarmaṇi—in inaction
context_kannada: ಇದು ಗೀತೆಯ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಶ್ಲೋಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದೆ, ಇದು ಕರ್ಮ ಯೋಗದ ಮೂಲ ತತ್ವವನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ಫಲಾಪೇಕ್ಷೆಯಿಲ್ಲದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆ. ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ನಾವು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಫಲಿತಾಂಶವನ್ನಲ್ಲ.
context_telugu: ఇది గీతలోని అత్యంత ప్రసిద్ధ శ్లోకాలలో ఒకటి, ఇది కర్మ యోగం యొక్క ప్రధాన సూత్రాన్ని స్థాపిస్తుంది: ఫలాపేక్ష లేని చర్య. మన ప్రయత్నాలను మాత్రమే మనం నియంత్రిస్తాం, ఫలితాన్ని ఎప్పుడూ కాదు.
commentary_english:
When you perform actions have no desire for the fruits thereof under any circumstances. If you thirst for the fruits of your actions, you will have to take birth again and again to enjoy them. Action done with expectation of fruits (rewards) brings bondage. If you do not thirst for them, you get purification of heart and you will get knowledge of the Self through purity of heart and through the knowledge of the Self you will be freed from the round of births and deaths.

Neither let thy attachment be towards inaction thinking what is the use of doing actions when I cannot get any reward for themIn a broad sense Karma means action. It also means duty which one has to perform according to his caste or station of life. According to the followers of the Karma Kanda of the Vedas (the Mimamsakas) Karma means the rituals and sacrifices prescribed in the Vedas. It has a deep meaning also. It signifies the destiny or the storehouse of tendencies of a man which give rise to his future birth.

commentary_kannada:
ನೀವು ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಯಾವುದೇ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲೂ ಅದರ ಫಲವನ್ನು ಬಯಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳ ಫಲಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ಬಾಯಾರಿಕೆಯಾದರೆ, ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಆನಂದಿಸಲು ನೀವು ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಜನ್ಮ ಪಡೆಯಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಫಲಗಳ (ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಗಳ) ನಿರೀಕ್ಷೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕಾರ್ಯವು ಬಂಧನವನ್ನು ತರುತ್ತದೆ. ನೀವು ಅವುಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಬಾಯಾರಿದಿದ್ದರೆ, ನೀವು ಹೃದಯದ ಶುದ್ಧಿಯನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತೀರಿ ಮತ್ತು ನೀವು ಹೃದಯದ ಶುದ್ಧತೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಆತ್ಮದ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತೀರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆತ್ಮದ ಜ್ಞಾನದ ಮೂಲಕ ನೀವು ಜನ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಮರಣದ ಸುತ್ತುಗಳಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತರಾಗುತ್ತೀರಿ.

ನಾನು ಅವರಿಗೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗದಿದ್ದಾಗ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಏನು ಪ್ರಯೋಜನ ಎಂದು ಯೋಚಿಸುವ ನಿಷ್ಕ್ರಿಯತೆಯ ಕಡೆಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಒಲವು ಇರಬಾರದು. ವಿಶಾಲ ಅರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ಮ ಎಂದರೆ ಕ್ರಿಯೆ. ಇದರರ್ಥ ಒಬ್ಬನು ತನ್ನ ಜಾತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಜೀವನದ ನಿಲುವಿಗೆ ಅನುಗುಣವಾಗಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ. ವೇದಗಳ (ಮೀಮಾಂಸಕರು) ಕರ್ಮ ಕಾಂಡದ ಅನುಯಾಯಿಗಳ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಕರ್ಮ ಎಂದರೆ ವೇದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂಚಿಸಲಾದ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ತ್ಯಾಗಗಳು. ಇದು ಆಳವಾದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಸಹ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಇದು ಅವನ ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಜನ್ಮಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುವ ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಹಣೆಬರಹ ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿಗಳ ಉಗ್ರಾಣವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

text:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते।।2.48।।
text_kannada:
ಯೋಗಸ್ಥಃ ಕುರು ಕರ್ಮಾಣಿ ಸಂಗಂ ತ್ಯಕ್ತ್ವಾ ಧನಂಜಯ |
ಸಿದ್ಧ್ಯಸಿದ್ಧ್ಯೋಃ ಸಮೋ ಭೂತ್ವಾ ಸಮತ್ವಂ ಯೋಗ ಉಚ್ಯತೇ || ೪೮ ||
text_telugu:
యోగస్థః కురు కర్మాణి సంగం త్యక్త్వా ధనంజయ |
సిద్ధ్యసిద్ధ్యోః సమో భూత్వా సమత్వం యోగ ఉచ్యతే || ౪౮ ||
transliteration:
yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya
siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga uchyate
translation_english: By being established in Yoga, O Dhananjaya (Arjuna), undertake actions, casting off attachment and remaining equanimous in success and failure. Equanimity is called Yoga.
translation_kannada: ಧನಂಜಯನೇ, ಆಸಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ತೊರೆದು ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲೆನಿಂತು ಕರ್ಮಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡು. ಸಿದ್ಧಿ ಅಸಿದ್ಧಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮನಾಗಿರು; ಈ ಸಮಭಾವವನ್ನೇ ಯೋಗ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.
translation_telugu: ధనంజయా! యోగంలో నిలిచి, సంగం వదిలి, కర్మఫలితాలు సిద్ధించడం, సిద్ధించకపోవడం ఈ రెంటినీ సమంగా భావించి కర్మలు చెయ్యి. ఆ సమత్వమే యోగమని చెప్పబడుతుంది.
context_english: yoga-sthaḥ—being steadfast in yog; kuru—perform; karmāṇi—duties; saṅgam—attachment; tyaktvā—having abandoned; dhanañjaya—Arjun; siddhi-asiddhyoḥ—in success and failure; samaḥ—equipoised; bhūtvā—becoming; samatvam—equanimity; yogaḥ—Yog; uchyate—is called
context_kannada: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಯೋಗವನ್ನು ಭೌತಿಕ ಭಂಗಿಗಳಾಗಿ ಅಲ್ಲದೆ, ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಸಮತೋಲನದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಎಂದು ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಮತ್ತು ವೈಫಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸಮಾನವಾಗಿ ನೋಡಬೇಕು.
context_telugu: కృష్ణుడు ఇక్కడ యోగాన్ని శారీరక భంగిమలుగా కాకుండా, మానసిక సమతుల్యత స్థితిగా నిర్వచిస్తున్నాడు. విజయం మరియు వైఫల్యాన్ని సమానంగా చూడాలి.
commentary_english: Dwelling in union with the Divine perform actions merely for Gods sake with a balanced mind in success and failure. Eilibrium is Yoga. The attainment of the knowledge of the Self through purity of heart obtained by doing actions without expectation of fruits is success (Siddhi). Failure is the nonattainment of knowledge by doing actions with expectation of fruit. (Cf.III.9IV.14IV.20).

commentary_kannada: ದೈವಿಕತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುವವರು ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಮತ್ತು ವೈಫಲ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮತೋಲಿತ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕೇವಲ ದೇವರಿಗಾಗಿ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಐಲೀಬ್ರಿಯಂ ಎಂದರೆ ಯೋಗ. ಫಲದ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಹೃದಯದ ಶುದ್ಧತೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಆತ್ಮಜ್ಞಾನದ ಸಾಧನೆಯೇ ಯಶಸ್ಸು (ಸಿದ್ಧಿ). ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ಎಂದರೆ ಫಲದ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯದಿರುವುದು. text:
दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनञ्जय।
बुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः।।2.49।।
text_kannada:
ದೂರೇಣ ಹ್ಯವರಂ ಕರ್ಮ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯೋಗಾದ್ಧನಂಜಯ |
ಬುದ್ಧೌ ಶರಣಮನ್ವಿಚ್ಛ ಕೃಪಣಾಃ ಫಲಹೇತವಃ || ೪೯ ||
text_telugu:
దూరేణ హ్యవరం కర్మ బుద్ధియోగాద్ధనంజయ |
బుద్ధౌ శరణమన్విచ్ఛ కృపణాః ఫలహేతవః || ౪౯ ||
transliteration:
dūreṇa hy-avaraṁ karma buddhi-yogād dhanañjaya
buddhau śharaṇam anvichchha kṛipaṇāḥ phala-hetavaḥ
translation_english: O Dhananjaya, indeed, action is inferior to the yoga of wisdom. Take refuge in wisdom. Those who thirst for rewards are pitiable.
translation_kannada: ಧನಂಜಯನೇ, ಬುದ್ಧಿಯೋಗಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಫಲದಾಸೆಯ ಕರ್ಮವು ಬಹಳ ಕೀಳಾದದ್ದು. ಬುದ್ಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಶ್ರಯವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕು; ಫಲವನ್ನೇ ಗುರಿಯಾಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡವರು ದೀನರು.
translation_telugu: ధనంజయా! సమత్వ బుద్ధితో కూడిన కర్మ కంటే కామ్యకర్మ చాలా అల్ప మైనది. కాబట్టి ఆసమ బుద్ధిని ఆశ్రయించు. కర్మఫలానికి కారకులయ్యేవారు పిసిని గొట్టులు.
context_english: dūreṇa—(discrad) from far away; hi—certainly; avaram—inferior; karma—reward-seeking actions; buddhi-yogāt—with the intellect established in Divine knowledge; dhanañjaya—Arjun; buddhau—divine knowledge and insight; śharaṇam—refuge; anvichchha—seek; kṛipaṇāḥ—miserly; phala-hetavaḥ—those seeking fruits of their work
commentary_english: Action done with evenness of mind is Yoga of wisdom. The yogi who is established in the Yoga of widdom is not affected by success or failure. He does not seek fruits of his actions. He has poised reason. His reason is rooted in the Self. Action performed by one who expects fruits for his actions, is far inferior to the Yoga of wisdom wherein the seeker does not seek fruits because the former leads to bondage and is the cause of birth and death. (Cf.VIII.18).

commentary_kannada: ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಸಮಾನತೆಯಿಂದ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯು ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯ ಯೋಗವಾಗಿದೆ. ಬುದ್ಧಿಯ ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿತನಾದ ಯೋಗಿಯು ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಅಥವಾ ವೈಫಲ್ಯದಿಂದ ಪ್ರಭಾವಿತನಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳ ಫಲವನ್ನು ಬಯಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆತನಿಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಿದೆ. ಅವನ ತರ್ಕವು ಆತ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರೂರಿದೆ. ತನ್ನ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಫಲವನ್ನು ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯು ಮಾಡುವ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯು ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯ ಯೋಗಕ್ಕಿಂತ ತುಂಬಾ ಕೆಳಮಟ್ಟದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ, ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಅನ್ವೇಷಕನು ಫಲವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಮೊದಲನೆಯದು ಬಂಧನಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಜನನ ಮತ್ತು ಮರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿದೆ. (Cf.VIII.18).

text:
बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते।
तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्।।2.50।।
text_kannada:
ಬುದ್ಧಿಯುಕ್ತೋ ಜಹಾತೀಹ ಉಭೇ ಸುಕೃತದುಷ್ಕೃತೇ |
ತಸ್ಮಾದ್ಯೋಗಾಯ ಯುಜ್ಯಸ್ವ ಯೋಗಃ ಕರ್ಮಸು ಕೌಶಲಮ್ || ೫೦ ||
text_telugu:
బుద్ధియుక్తో జహాతీహ ఉభే సుకృతదుష్కృతే |
తస్మాద్యోగాయ యుజ్యస్వ యోగః కర్మసు కౌశలమ్ || ౫౦ ||
transliteration:
buddhi-yukto jahātīha ubhe sukṛita-duṣhkṛite
tasmād yogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśhalam
translation_english: Possessed of wisdom, one rejects here both virtue and vice. Therefore, devote yourself to (Karma-) yoga; for yoga is skilfulness in action.
translation_kannada: ಬುದ್ಧಿಯಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದವನು ಇಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಪುಣ್ಯ ಪಾಪಗಳೆರಡನ್ನೂ ತೊರೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಯೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿದ್ಧನಾಗು; ಕರ್ಮಗಳಲ್ಲಿನ ಕೌಶಲವೇ ಯೋಗ.
translation_telugu: సమబుద్ధితో కూడిన వ్యక్తి ఈ జన్మలోనే పుణ్య పాపాలని రెంటినీ వదులుతాడు. అందుచేత నీవు యోగంకోసం ప్రయత్నించు. యోగమంటే కర్మలలో కౌశలమే.
context_english: buddhi-yuktaḥ—endowed with wisdom; jahāti—get rid of; iha—in this life; ubhe—both; sukṛita-duṣhkṛite—good and bad deeds; tasmāt—therefore; yogāya—for Yog; yujyasva—strive for; yogaḥ—yog is; karmasu kauśhalam—the art of working skillfully
commentary_english:
Work performed with motive towards fruits only can bind a man. It will bring the fruits and the performer of the action will have to take birth again in this mortal world to enjoy them. If work is performed with evennes of mind (the Yoga of wisdom, i.e.? united to pure Buddhi, intelligence or reason) with the mind resting in the Lord, it will not bind him it will not bring any fruit it is no work at all.

Actions which are of a binding nature lose that nature when performed with equanimity of mind, or poised reason. The Yogi of poised reason attributes all actions to the Divine Actor within (Isvara or God).

commentary_kannada:
ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳ ಉದ್ದೇಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾತ್ರ ಮನುಷ್ಯನನ್ನು ಬಂಧಿಸಬಲ್ಲದು. ಇದು ಫಲವನ್ನು ತರುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರದರ್ಶಿಸುವವರು ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಆನಂದಿಸಲು ಈ ಮರ್ತ್ಯ ಜಗತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಜನಿಸಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಭಗವಂತನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ (ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯ ಯೋಗ, ಅಂದರೆ ಶುದ್ಧ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ, ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ತರ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿದ) ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದರೆ, ಅದು ಅವನನ್ನು ಬಂಧಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಅದು ಯಾವುದೇ ಫಲವನ್ನು ತರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

ಬಂಧಿಸುವ ಸ್ವಭಾವದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಸಮಚಿತ್ತತೆಯಿಂದ ಅಥವಾ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾದ ತರ್ಕದಿಂದ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆ ಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಿದ್ಧ ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತ ಯೋಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಆಂತರಿಕ ದೈವಿಕ ನಟನಿಗೆ (ಈಶ್ವರ ಅಥವಾ ದೇವರು) ಕಾರಣವೆಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.

text:
कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः।
जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम्।।2.51।।
text_kannada:
ಕರ್ಮಜಂ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯುಕ್ತಾ ಹಿ ಫಲಂ ತ್ಯಕ್ತ್ವಾ ಮನೀಷಿಣಃ |
ಜನ್ಮಬಂಧವಿನಿರ್ಮುಕ್ತಾಃ ಪದಂ ಗಚ್ಛಂತ್ಯನಾಮಯಮ್ || ೫೧ ||
text_telugu:
కర్మజం బుద్ధియుక్తా హి ఫలం త్యక్త్వా మనీషిణః |
జన్మబంధవినిర్ముక్తాః పదం గచ్ఛంత్యనామయమ్ || ౫౧ ||
transliteration:
karma-jaṁ buddhi-yuktā hi phalaṁ tyaktvā manīṣhiṇaḥ
janma-bandha-vinirmuktāḥ padaṁ gachchhanty-anāmayam
translation_english: For those devoted to wisdom, they become enlightened men by giving up the fruits of their actions, and thus they reach a state beyond evil, having been freed from the bondage of birth.
translation_kannada: ಬುದ್ಧಿಯಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದ ಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ಕರ್ಮದಿಂದ ಹುಟ್ಟುವ ಫಲವನ್ನು ತೊರೆದು, ಜನ್ಮದ ಬಂಧನದಿಂದ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಪಡೆದು, ದುಃಖವಿಲ್ಲದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಸೇರುತ್ತಾರೆ.
translation_telugu: సమబుద్ధితో కర్మనుండి జనించే ఫలితమునందు ఆసక్తి త్యజించే వివేకులు జన్మబంధం నుండి పూర్తిగా విముక్తులై దుఃఖరహితమైన పదాన్ని చేరుకుంటారు.
context_english: karma-jam—born of fruitive actions; buddhi-yuktāḥ—endowed with equanimity of intellect; hi—as; phalam—fruits; tyaktvā—abandoning; manīṣhiṇaḥ—the wise; janma-bandha-vinirmuktāḥ—freedom from the bondage of life and death; padam—state; gachchhanti—attain; anāmayam—devoid of sufferings
commentary_english:
Clinging to the fruits of actions is the cause of rirth. Man takes a body to enjoy them. If anyone performs actions for the sake of God in fulfilment of His purpose without desire for the fruits, he is released from the bonds of birth and attains to the blissful state or the immortal abode.Sages who possess evenness of mind abandon the fruits of their actions and thus escape from good and bad actions.

Buddhi referred to in the three verses 49? 50 and 51 may be the wisdom of the Sankhyas, i.e.? the knowledge of the Self or AtmaJnana which dawns when the mind is purified by Karma Yoga.

commentary_kannada:
ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳ ಫಲಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಟಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಪುಣ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿದೆ. ಮನುಷ್ಯನು ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಆನಂದಿಸಲು ಒಂದು ದೇಹವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಫಲದ ಬಯಕೆಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಭಗವಂತನ ಉದ್ದೇಶವನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸಲು ಯಾರಾದರೂ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದರೆ, ಅವನು ಜನ್ಮದ ಬಂಧಗಳಿಂದ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆನಂದಮಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಅಮರ ವಾಸಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಸಮಾನತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಋಷಿಗಳು ತಮ್ಮ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳ ಫಲವನ್ನು ತ್ಯಜಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೀಗೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಿಂದ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.

49? 50 ಮತ್ತು 51ನೇ ಮೂರು ಶ್ಲೋಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿಸಲಾದ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯು ಸಾಂಖ್ಯರ ಜ್ಞಾನವಾಗಿರಬಹುದು, ಅಂದರೆ ಕರ್ಮ ಯೋಗದಿಂದ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಶುದ್ಧಗೊಂಡಾಗ ಉದಯಿಸುವ ಆತ್ಮ ಅಥವಾ ಆತ್ಮಜ್ಞಾನದ ಜ್ಞಾನವಾಗಿರಬಹುದು.

text:
यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति।
तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च।।2.52।।
text_kannada:
ಯದಾ ತೇ ಮೋಹಕಲಿಲಂ ಬುದ್ಧಿರ್ವ್ಯತಿತರಿಷ್ಯತಿ |
ತದಾ ಗಂತಾಸಿ ನಿರ್ವೇದಂ ಶ್ರೋತವ್ಯಸ್ಯ ಶ್ರುತಸ್ಯ ಚ || ೫೨ ||
text_telugu:
యదా తే మోహకలిలం బుద్ధిర్వ్యతితరిష్యతి |
తదా గంతాసి నిర్వేదం శ్రోతవ్యస్య శ్రుతస్య చ || ౫౨ ||
transliteration:
yadā te moha-kalilaṁ buddhir vyatitariṣhyati
tadā gantāsi nirvedaṁ śhrotavyasya śhrutasya cha
translation_english: When your mind goes beyond the turbidity of delusion, then you will acquire dispassion for what has to be heard and what has already been heard.
translation_kannada: ನಿನ್ನ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯು ಮೋಹದ ಕೆಸರನ್ನು ದಾಟಿದಾಗ, ಕೇಳಿದ್ದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆಯೂ ಕೇಳಬೇಕಾದ್ದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆಯೂ ನಿನಗೆ ವಿರಕ್ತಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
translation_telugu: ఎప్పుడు నీబుద్ధి మోహమనే బురదని అధిగమిస్తుందో, అప్పుడు వినదగిన, వినిన విషయాలనుండి విముక్తుడివి అవుతావు.
context_english: yadā—when; te—your; moha—delusion; kalilam—quagmire; buddhiḥ—intellect; vyatitariṣhyati—crosses; tadā—then; gantāsi—you shall acquire; nirvedam—indifferent; śhrotavyasya—to what is yet to be heard; śhrutasya—to what has been heard; cha—and
commentary_english: The mire of delusion is the identification of the Self with the notself. The sense of discrimination between the Self and the notSelf is confounded by the mire of delusion and the mind runs towards the sensual objects and the body is takes as the pure Self. When you attain purity of mind, you will attain to indifference regarding things heard and yet to be heard. They will appear to you to be of no use. You will not care a bit for them. You will entertain disgust for them. (Cf.XVI.24).

commentary_kannada: ಭ್ರಮೆಯ ಕೆಸರೆಂದರೆ ಆತ್ಮವನ್ನು ತನ್ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಗುರುತಿಸುವುದು. ಆತ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಆತ್ಮವಲ್ಲದವರ ನಡುವಿನ ತಾರತಮ್ಯದ ಭಾವವು ಭ್ರಮೆಯ ಕೆಸರಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಗೊಂದಲಕ್ಕೊಳಗಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮನಸ್ಸು ಇಂದ್ರಿಯ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಓಡುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಶುದ್ಧ ಆತ್ಮವಾಗಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ನೀವು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಶುದ್ಧತೆಯನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಿದಾಗ, ಕೇಳಲಾಗುವ ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್ನೂ ಕೇಳಲಾಗದ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನೀವು ಉದಾಸೀನತೆಯನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಅವು ನಿಮಗೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನವಿಲ್ಲವೆಂದು ತೋರುತ್ತದೆ. ನೀವು ಅವರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪವೂ ತಲೆಕೆಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ನೀವು ಅವರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಸಹ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸುವಿರಿ. (Cf.XVI.24).

text:
श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना ते यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला।
समाधावचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगमवाप्स्यसि।।2.53।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರುತಿವಿಪ್ರತಿಪನ್ನಾ ತೇ ಯದಾ ಸ್ಥಾಸ್ಯತಿ ನಿಶ್ಚಲಾ |
ಸಮಾಧಾವಚಲಾ ಬುದ್ಧಿಸ್ತದಾ ಯೋಗಮವಾಪ್ಸ್ಯಸಿ || ೫೩ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రుతివిప్రతిపన్నా తే యదా స్థాస్యతి నిశ్చలా |
సమాధావచలా బుద్ధిస్తదా యోగమవాప్స్యసి || ౫౩ ||
transliteration:
śhruti-vipratipannā te yadā sthāsyati niśhchalā
samādhāv-achalā buddhis tadā yogam avāpsyasi
translation_english: When your mind, which has become bewildered by hearing, becomes unshakable and steadfast in the Self, then you will attain Yoga that arises from discrimination.
translation_kannada: ಬಗೆಬಗೆಯ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ಕಲಕಿದ ನಿನ್ನ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯು ಅಚಲವಾಗಿ ಸಮಾಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲೆನಿಂತಾಗ ನೀನು ಯೋಗವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತೀಯೆ.
translation_telugu: విన్నవాటితో వేసారిపోయిన నీబుద్ధి సమాధిలో నిశ్చలంగా నిలిచి ఉన్నప్పుడు నీవు యోగాన్ని పొందుతావు.
context_english: śhruti-vipratipannā—not allured by the fruitive sections of the Vedas; te—your; yadā—when; sthāsyati—remains; niśhchalā—steadfast; samādhau—in divine consciousness; achalā—steadfast; buddhiḥ—intellect; tadā—at that time; yogam—Yog; avāpsyasi—you will attain
commentary_english: When your intellect which is tossed about by the conflict of opinions regarding the Pravritti Marga (the path of action) and the Nivritti Marga (the path of retirement or renunciation) has become immovable without distraction and doubt and firmly established in the Self, then thou shalt attain Selfrealisation or knowledge of the Self (AtmaJnana).
translation_kannada_source: machine-assisted — rendered from the Sanskrit, no traditional Kannada edition
commentary_kannada: ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ ಮಾರ್ಗ (ಕಾರ್ಯಮಾರ್ಗ) ಮತ್ತು ನಿವೃತ್ತಿ ಮಾರ್ಗ (ನಿವೃತ್ತಿ ಅಥವಾ ತ್ಯಾಗ ಮಾರ್ಗ) ದ ಬಗೆಗಿನ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳ ಸಂಘರ್ಷದಿಂದ ತೂಗಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯು ಯಾವುದೇ ಗೊಂದಲ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂದೇಹಗಳಿಲ್ಲದೆ ನಿಶ್ಚಲವಾಗಿ ಆತ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ದೃಢವಾಗಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿತವಾದಾಗ, ಆಗ ನೀವು ಆತ್ಮಸಾಕ್ಷಾತ್ಕಾರ ಅಥವಾ ಆತ್ಮಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು (ಆತ್ಮಜ್ಞಾನ) ಸಾಧಿಸುತ್ತೀರಿ.

text:
अर्जुन उवाच
स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव।
स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम्।।2.54।।
text_kannada:
ಅರ್ಜುನ ಉವಾಚ |
ಸ್ಥಿತಪ್ರಜ್ಞಸ್ಯ ಕಾ ಭಾಷಾ ಸಮಾಧಿಸ್ಥಸ್ಯ ಕೇಶವ |
ಸ್ಥಿತಧೀಃ ಕಿಂ ಪ್ರಭಾಷೇತ ಕಿಮಾಸೀತ ವ್ರಜೇತ ಕಿಮ್ || ೫೪ ||
text_telugu:
అర్జున ఉవాచ |
స్థితప్రజ్ఞస్య కా భాషా సమాధిస్థస్య కేశవ |
స్థితధీః కిం ప్రభాషేత కిమాసీత వ్రజేత కిమ్ || ౫౪ ||
transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
sthita-prajñasya kā bhāṣhā samādhi-sthasya keśhava
sthita-dhīḥ kiṁ prabhāṣheta kim āsīta vrajeta kim
translation_english: Arjuna said, "O Kesava, what is the description of a man of steady wisdom who is self-absorbed? How does he speak, sit, and move about?"
translation_kannada: ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಹೇಳಿದನು. ಕೇಶವಾ, ಸಮಾಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲೆನಿಂತ ಸ್ಥಿತಪ್ರಜ್ಞನ ಲಕ್ಷಣವೇನು? ಸ್ಥಿರವಾದ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯುಳ್ಳವನು ಹೇಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಹೇಗೆ ಕುಳಿತಿರುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಹೇಗೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ?
translation_telugu: అర్జునుడు ఇలా అడిగాడు: కేశవా సమాధి కలిగిన స్తితప్రజ్ఞుడి లక్షణం ఏమిటి? స్థిరబుద్ధి కలిగినవాడు ఎలా మాట్లాడుతాడు? ఎలా కూర్చుంటాడు? ఎలా నడుచుకుంటాడు?
context_english: arjunaḥ uvācha—Arjun said; sthita-prajñasya—one with steady intellect; kā—what; bhāṣhā—talk; samādhi-sthasya—situated in divine consciousness; keśhava—Shree Krishna, killer of the Keshi Demon; sthita-dhīḥ—enlightened person; kim—what; prabhāṣheta—talks; kim—how; āsīta—sits; vrajeta—walks; kim—how
commentary_english: Arjuna wants to know from Lord Krishna the characteristic marks of one who is established in the Self in Samadhi how he speaks, how he sits, how he moves about.The characteristic marks of the sage of steady wisdom and the means of attaining that steady knowledge of the Self are described in the verses from 55 to 72 of this chapter.Steady wisdom is settled knowledge of ones identity with Brahman attained by direct realisation. (Cf.XIV.21? 27).

text:
श्री भगवानुवाच
प्रजहाति यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्।
आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते।।2.55।।
text_kannada:
ಶ್ರೀ ಭಗವಾನುವಾಚ |
ಪ್ರಜಹಾತಿ ಯದಾ ಕಾಮಾನ್ ಸರ್ವಾನ್ ಪಾರ್ಥ ಮನೋಗತಾನ್ |
ಆತ್ಮನ್ಯೇವಾತ್ಮನಾ ತುಷ್ಟಃ ಸ್ಥಿತಪ್ರಜ್ಞಸ್ತದೋಚ್ಯತೇ || ೫೫ ||
text_telugu:
శ్రీ భగవానువాచ |
ప్రజహాతి యదా కామాన్ సర్వాన్ పార్థ మనోగతాన్ |
ఆత్మన్యేవాత్మనా తుష్టః స్థితప్రజ్ఞస్తదోచ్యతే || ౫౫ ||
transliteration:
śhrī bhagavān uvācha
prajahāti yadā kāmān sarvān pārtha mano-gatān
ātmany-evātmanā tuṣhṭaḥ sthita-prajñas tadochyate
translation_english: The Blessed One said, "O Partha, when one fully renounces all the desires that have entered the mind and remains satisfied in the Self alone, then he is called a man of steady wisdom."
translation_kannada: ಶ್ರೀಭಗವಂತನು ಹೇಳಿದನು. ಪಾರ್ಥನೇ, ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಎಲ್ಲ ಬಯಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಯಾವನು ಬಿಟ್ಟುಬಿಡುತ್ತಾನೋ, ತನ್ನಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ತಾನು ತೃಪ್ತನಾಗಿರುತ್ತಾನೋ, ಅವನನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಿತಪ್ರಜ್ಞ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.
translation_telugu: భగవానుడు ఇలా బదులిచ్చాడు: అర్జునా! మనస్సులోని అన్ని కోరికలని ఎప్పుడు విసర్జిస్తాడొ, ఎప్పుడు తనలో తాను తుస్టిని(ఆత్మానందాన్ని) పొందుతాడో, అప్పుడు స్తితప్రజ్ఞుడు అనిపించుకుంటాడు.
context_english: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—The Supreme Lord said; prajahāti—discards; yadā—when; kāmān—selfish desires; sarvān—all; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; manaḥ-gatān—of the mind; ātmani—of the self; eva—only; ātmanā—by the purified mind; tuṣhṭaḥ—satisfied; sthita-prajñaḥ—one with steady intellect; tadā—at that time; uchyate—is said
context_telugu: ఇక్కడ మనస్సు ఆలోచనలకు తావులేదు. స్థితి అయిన సమాధి స్థితిలో ఆలోచనలు వుండవు; స్పృహ వుండదు; మనస్సు నిశ్చలమై వుంటుంది; సమయం తెలియదు. ఇక్కడే సత్యాన్ని లేదా సత్య-స్థితిని పొందవచ్చు,మనస్సు ఆలోచనల స్థితిని దాటినప్పుడే బ్రహ్మo సత్యం తెలుస్తుంది ఈ సమాధి స్థితిలోకి వెళ్ళిన తరువాతే సత్యాన్ని తెలుసుకోవటం జరుగవచ్చుసమాధి స్థితి సత్యాన్ని గురించి ఎవరూ, ఎవరికీ బోధించలేరు.మనస్సు నిశ్చలంగా, స్థిరంగా మనస్సునిలుకడ తెలియర గురువు అనుగ్రహంవల్ల సూక్ష్మత తత్త్వాన్ని… సాధనల యొక్క అత్యున్నత లక్ష్యం దైవ ( ఆత్మ )సాక్షాత్కారం అని ..గురువు ద్వారానే అతి సులభముగా పొందగలం.
commentary_english: In this verse Lord Krishna gives His answer to the first part of Arjunas question.If anyone gets sugarcandy will he crave for blacksugar Certainly not. If anyone can attain the supreme bliss of the Self, will he thirst for the sensual pleasures No, not at all. The sumtotal of all the pleasures of the world will seem worthless for the sage of steady wisdom who is satisfied in the Self. (Cf.III.17VI.7?8).

text:
दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः।
वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते।।2.56।।
text_kannada:
ದುಃಖೇಷ್ವನುದ್ವಿಗ್ನಮನಾಃ ಸುಖೇಷು ವಿಗತಸ್ಪೃಹಃ |
ವೀತರಾಗಭಯಕ್ರೋಧಃ ಸ್ಥಿತಧೀರ್ಮುನಿರುಚ್ಯತೇ || ೫೬ ||
text_telugu:
దుఃఖేష్వనుద్విగ్నమనాః సుఖేషు విగతస్పృహః |
వీతరాగభయక్రోధః స్థితధీర్మునిరుచ్యతే || ౫౬ ||
transliteration:
duḥkheṣhv-anudvigna-manāḥ sukheṣhu vigata-spṛihaḥ
vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhaḥ sthita-dhīr munir uchyate
translation_english: That monk is called a man of steady wisdom when his mind is unperturbed even in sorrow, he is free from longing for delights, and has gone beyond attachment, fear, and anger.
translation_kannada: ದುಃಖಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಳವಳಗೊಳ್ಳದ, ಸುಖಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಆಸೆಯಿಲ್ಲದ, ರಾಗ ಭಯ ಕೋಪಗಳನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡ ಮುನಿಯನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಿರಬುದ್ಧಿಯುಳ್ಳವನು ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.
translation_telugu: ధుఃఖాలలో ఉద్వేగం పొందనివాడు, సుఖాలకోసం తహతహ పడనివాడు, రాగ భయ, క్రోదాలని విడిచినవాడు మననశీలుడు, స్థితప్రజ్ఞుడు అనిపించుకుంటాడు.
context_english: duḥkheṣhu—amidst miseries; anudvigna-manāḥ—one whose mind is undisturbed; sukheṣhu—in pleasure; vigata-spṛihaḥ—without craving; vīta—free from; rāga—attachment; bhaya—fear; krodhaḥ—anger; sthita-dhīḥ—enlightened person; muniḥ—a sage; uchyate—is called
commentary_english: Lord Krishna gives His answer to the second part of Arjunas question as to the conduct of a sage of steady wisdom in the 56th? 57th and 58th verses.The mind of a sage of steady wisdom is not distressed in calamities. He is not affected by the three afflictions (Taapas) -- Adhyatmika (arising from diseases or disorders in ones own body)? Adhidaivika (arising from thunder, lightning, storm, flood, etc.), and Adhibhautika (arising from scorpions, cobras, tigers, etc.). When he is placed in an affluent condition he does not long for sensual pleasures. (Cf.IV.10).

text:
यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम्।
नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता।।2.57।।
text_kannada:
ಯಃ ಸರ್ವತ್ರಾನಭಿಸ್ನೇಹಸ್ತತ್ತತ್ಪ್ರಾಪ್ಯ ಶುಭಾಶುಭಮ್ |
ನಾಭಿನಂದತಿ ನ ದ್ವೇಷ್ಟಿ ತಸ್ಯ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞಾ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಿತಾ || ೫೭ ||
text_telugu:
యః సర్వత్రానభిస్నేహస్తత్తత్ప్రాప్య శుభాశుభమ్ |
నాభినందతి న ద్వేష్టి తస్య ప్రజ్ఞా ప్రతిష్ఠితా || ౫౭ ||
transliteration:
yaḥ sarvatrānabhisnehas tat tat prāpya śhubhāśhubham
nābhinandati na dveṣhṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
translation_english: The wisdom of that person remains established who has no attachment to anything anywhere, who neither welcomes nor rejects anything, whatever good or bad, when they come across it.
translation_kannada: ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಅಂಟಿಲ್ಲದವನಾಗಿ, ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದೋ ಕೆಟ್ಟದ್ದೋ ಯಾವುದು ಬಂದರೂ ಹಿಗ್ಗದ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ವೇಷಿಸದ ಅವನ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿದೆ.
translation_telugu: ఎక్కడా దేనికీ తగుల్కోకుండా, శుభాశుభాలను పొందినప్పుడు ఆనందించక, ద్వేషించక నిలిచివుంటాడో అతడి ప్రజ్ఞ స్థిరమైనది.
context_english: yaḥ—who; sarvatra—in all conditions; anabhisnehaḥ—unattached; tat—that; tat—that; prāpya—attaining; śhubha—good; aśhubham—evil; na—neither; abhinandati—delight in; na—nor; dveṣhṭi—dejected by; tasya—his; prajñā—knowledge; pratiṣhṭhitā—is fixed
commentary_english: The sage possesses poised understanding or evenness of mind. He does not rejoice in pleasure nor is he averse to pain that may befall him. He is quite indifferent as he is rooted in the Self. He has no attachment even for his life or body as he identifies himself with Brahman or the Supreme Self. He will not praise anybody when the latter does any good to him nor censure anyone when one does him any harm. commentary_english:
Withdrawal of the senses is Pratyahara or abstraction. The mind has a natural,tendency to run towards external objects. The Yogi again and again withdraws the mind from the objects of the senses and fixes it on the Self. A Yogi who is endowed with the power of Pratyahara can enter into Samadhi even in a crowded place by withdrawing his senses within the twinkling of an eye.

He is not disturbed by tumultuous sounds and noises of any description. Even on the battlefield he can rest in his centre, the Self, by withdrawing his senses. He who practises Pratyahara is dead to the world. He will not be affected by the outside vibrations. At any time by mere willing he can bring his senses under his perfect control. They are his obedient servants or instruments.

వశే హి యస్యేంద్రియాణి తస్య ప్రజ్ఞా ప్రతిష్ఠితా || ౬౧ ||
transliteration:
tāni sarvāṇi sanyamya yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ
vaśhe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
translation_english: Controlling all of them, one should remain focused on Me as the supreme. For, the wisdom of one whose senses are under control becomes steadfast.
translation_kannada: ಆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಗಳನ್ನು ಹತೋಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು, ನನ್ನಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಟ್ಟು ಯೋಗಿಯಾಗಿ ಇರಬೇಕು. ಯಾರ ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಗಳು ವಶದಲ್ಲಿವೆಯೋ ಅವನ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿದೆ.
translation_telugu: వాటినన్నింటిని బాగా నిగ్రహించి, యుక్తుడై నన్ను లక్ష్యంగా పెట్టుకొని ఉండాలి. ఎవరి ఇంద్రియాలు స్వాధీనంలో ఉంటాయో అతడి ప్రజ్ఞే నిలకడగా ఉంటుంది.
context_english: tāni—them; sarvāṇi—all; sanyamya—subduing; yuktaḥ—united; āsīta—seated; mat-paraḥ—toward me (Shree Krishna); vaśhe—control; hi—certainly; yasya—whose; indriyāṇi—senses; tasya—their; prajñā—perfect knowledge pratiṣhṭhitā
commentary_english: He should control the senses and sit focussed on Me as the Supreme, with a calm mind. The wisdom of the Yogi who thus seated has brought all his senses under subjugation is doubtless quite steady. He is established in the Self. Sri Sankaracharya explains Asita Matparah as He should sit contemplating I am no other than He. (Cf.II.64).

commentary_kannada: ಅವನು ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಂತ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಿಂದ, ಪರಮಾತ್ಮನಾಗಿ ನನ್ನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಕೃತವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು. ಹೀಗೆ ಕುಳಿತಿರುವ ಯೋಗಿಯ ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯು ಅವನ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಗಳನ್ನು ಅಧೀನಗೊಳಿಸಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂದೇಹವಿಲ್ಲ. ಆತನು ಆತ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿತನಾಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಶ್ರೀ ಶಂಕರಾಚಾರ್ಯರು ಅಸಿತಾ ಮಟ್ಪರಾವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಅವನು ನಾನು ಅವನ ಹೊರತು ಬೇರೆ ಯಾರೂ ಅಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಯೋಚಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಕುಳಿತುಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. text:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते।
सङ्गात् संजायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते।।2.62।।
text_kannada:
ಧ್ಯಾಯತೋ ವಿಷಯಾನ್ಪುಂಸಃ ಸಂಗಸ್ತೇಷೂಪಜಾಯತೇ |
ಸಂಗಾತ್ ಸಂಜಾಯತೇ ಕಾಮಃ ಕಾಮಾತ್ಕ್ರೋಧೋಽಭಿಜಾಯತೇ || ೬೨ ||
text_telugu:
ధ్యాయతో విషయాన్పుంసః సంగస్తేషూపజాయతే |
సంగాత్ సంజాయతే కామః కామాత్క్రోధోఽభిజాయతే || ౬౨ ||
transliteration:
dhyāyato viṣhayān puṁsaḥ saṅgas teṣhūpajāyate
saṅgāt sañjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodho ’bhijāyate
translation_english: In the case of a person who dwells on objects, there arises attachment to them. From attachment grows hankering, and from hankering springs anger.
translation_kannada: ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಚಿಂತಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಮನುಷ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಅವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಟು ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ; ಅಂಟಿನಿಂದ ಬಯಕೆ ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ, ಬಯಕೆಯಿಂದ ಕೋಪ ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ.
translation_telugu: విషయధ్యానం చేసే పురుషుడికి వాటితో సంగమం ఏర్పడుతుంది. సంగమం వలన కామము, కామం వలన క్రోధం జనిస్తాయి.
context_english: dhyāyataḥ—contemplating; viṣhayān—sense objects; puṁsaḥ—of a person; saṅgaḥ—attachment; teṣhu—to them (sense objects); upajāyate—arises; saṅgāt—from attachment; sañjāyate—develops; kāmaḥ—desire; kāmāt—from desire; krodhaḥ—anger; abhijāyate—arises
commentary_english: When a man thinks of the beauty and the pleasant and alluring features of the senseobjects he becomes attached to them. He then regards them as something worthy of acquisition and possession and hankers after them. He develops a strong desire to possess them. Then he endeavours his level best to obtain them. When his desire is frustrated by some cause or other, anger arises in his mind. If anybody puts any obstruction in his way of obtaining the objects he hates him, fights with him and develops hostility towards hi. (Cf.II.64).

commentary_kannada: ಮನುಷ್ಯನು ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಗಳ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಆಹ್ಲಾದಕರ ಮತ್ತು ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಯೋಚಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅವನು ಅವುಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಂಟಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನಂತರ ಅವನು ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ವಾಧೀನಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಾಧೀನಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಯೋಗ್ಯವಾದದ್ದು ಎಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹಾತೊರೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದುವ ಬಲವಾದ ಬಯಕೆಯನ್ನು ಅವನು ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನಂತರ ಅವನು ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಲು ತನ್ನ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಯಾವುದೋ ಒಂದು ಕಾರಣದಿಂದ ಅವನ ಬಯಕೆಯು ಕುಂಠಿತಗೊಂಡಾಗ, ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಪವು ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವನು ದ್ವೇಷಿಸುವ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುವಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾರಾದರೂ ಅಡ್ಡಿಪಡಿಸಿದರೆ, ಅವನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಜಗಳವಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅವನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ದ್ವೇಷವನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. (Cf.II.64).
